name: Bulbasaur
description: While it is young, it uses the nutrients that are stored in the seed on its back in order to grow.

name: Ivysaur
description: Exposure to sunlight adds to its strength. Sunlight also makes the bud on its back grow larger.

name: Venusaur
description: A bewitching aroma wafts from its flower. The fragrance becalms those engaged in a battle.

name: Charmander
description: From the time it is born, a flame burns at the tip of its tail. Its life would end if the flame were to go out.

name: Charmeleon
description: If it becomes agitated during battle, it spouts intense flames, incinerating its surroundings.

name: Charizard
description: Its wings can carry this Pokémon close to an altitude of 4,600 feet. It blows out fire at very high temperatures.

name: Squirtle
description: When it feels threatened, it draws its limbs inside its shell and sprays water from its mouth.

name: Wartortle
description: It cleverly controls its furry ears and tail to maintain its balance while swimming.

name: Blastoise
description: The rocket cannons on its shell fire jets of water capable of punching holes through thick steel.

name: Caterpie
description: Its short feet are tipped with suction pads that enable it to tirelessly climb slopes and walls.

name: Metapod
description: Even though it is encased in a sturdy shell, the body inside is tender. It can’t withstand a harsh attack.

name: Butterfree
description: It collects honey every day. It rubs honey onto the hairs on its legs to carry it back to its nest.

name: Weedle
description: Beware of the sharp stinger on its head. It hides in grass and bushes where it eats leaves.

name: Kakuna
description: Able to move only slightly. When endangered, it may stick out its stinger and poison its enemy.

name: Beedrill
description: It has three poisonous stingers on its forelegs and its tail. They are used to jab its enemy repeatedly.

name: Pidgey
description: Very docile. If attacked, it will often kick up sand to protect itself rather than fight back.

name: Pidgeotto
description: This Pokémon is full of vitality. It constantly flies around its large territory in search of prey.

name: Pidgeot
description: This Pokémon flies at Mach 2 speed, seeking prey. Its large talons are feared as wicked weapons.

name: Rattata
description: Will chew on anything with its fangs. If you see one, you can be certain that 40 more live in the area.

name: Raticate
description: Its hind feet are webbed. They act as flippers, so it can swim in rivers and hunt for prey.

name: Spearow
description: Inept at flying high. However, it can fly around very fast to protect its territory.

name: Fearow
description: A Pokémon that dates back many years. If it senses danger, it flies high and away, instantly.

name: Ekans
description: The older it gets, the longer it grows. At night, it wraps its long body around tree branches to rest.

name: Arbok
description: The frightening patterns on its belly have been studied. Six variations have been confirmed.

name: Pikachu
description: Possesses cheek sacs in which it stores electricity. This clever forest-dweller roasts tough berries with an electric shock before consuming them.

name: Raichu
description: If its electric pouches run empty, it raises its tail to gather electricity from the atmosphere.

name: Sandshrew
description: It burrows into the ground to create its nest. If hard stones impede its tunneling, it uses its sharp claws to shatter them and then carries on digging.

name: Sandslash
description: It is skilled at slashing enemies with its claws. If broken, they start to grow back in a day.

name: Nidoran♀
description: It uses its hard incisor teeth to crush and eat berries. The tip of a female Nidoran’s horn is a bit more rounded than the tip of a male’s horn.

name: Nidorina
description: If the group is threatened, these Pokémon will band together to assault enemies with a chorus of ultrasonic waves.

name: Nidoqueen
description: It pacifies offspring by placing them in the gaps between the spines on its back. The spines will never secrete poison while young are present.

name: Nidoran♂
description: Small but brave, this Pokémon will hold its ground and even risk its life in battle to protect the female it’s friendly with.

name: Nidorino
description: It’s nervous and quick to act aggressively. The potency of its poison increases along with the level of adrenaline present in its body.

name: Nidoking
description: Its steel-like hide adds to its powerful tackle. Its horns are so hard, they can pierce a diamond.

name: Clefairy
description: It can be found in quiet mountain areas on a full moon's night. Its dancing and its tiny, faintly glowing wings confer upon it a lovely fairylike quality.

name: Clefable
description: Legend says that on clear, quiet nights, it listens for the voices of its kin living on the moon. I, too, often think of my homeland, so far away.

name: Vulpix
description: As each tail grows, its fur becomes more lustrous. When held, it feels slightly warm.

name: Ninetales
description: The coat of gleaming golden fur is quite magnificent. This species is said to store sacred power in its nine long tails and to live for a millennium.

name: Jigglypuff
description: Uses its cute round eyes to enrapture its foe. It then sings a pleasing melody that lulls the foe to sleep.

name: Wigglytuff
description: It’s proud of its fur, which is fine and delicate. In particular, the curl on its forehead has a texture that’s perfectly heavenly.

name: Zubat
description: Makes its home in gloomy caves. Atrophied eyes have left this Pokémon blind, so it scans its surroundings via sound waves that it emits from its mouth as it flies.

name: Golbat
description: It sinks its sharp fangs into other creatures and slurps up their blood. A closer look at the fangs reveals that they are hollow and akin to straws.

name: Oddish
description: During the day, it stays in the cold underground to avoid the sun. It grows by bathing in moonlight.

name: Gloom
description: What appears to be drool is actually sweet honey. It is very sticky and clings stubbornly if touched.

name: Vileplume
description: The larger its petals, the more toxic pollen it contains. Its big head is heavy and hard to hold up.

name: Paras
description: Burrows under the ground to gnaw on tree roots. The mushrooms on its back absorb most of the nutrition.

name: Parasect
description: The bug host is drained of energy by the mushroom on its back. The mushroom appears to do all the thinking.

name: Venonat
description: Its large eyes act as radar. In a bright place, you can see that they are clusters of many tiny eyes.

name: Venomoth
description: The powdery scales on its wings are hard to remove from skin. They also contain poison that leaks out on contact.

name: Diglett
description: It burrows through the ground at a shallow depth. It leaves raised earth in its wake, making it easy to spot.

name: Dugtrio
description: A team of triplets that can burrow to a depth of 60 miles. It’s reported that this triggers an earthquake.

name: Meowth
description: It loves to collect shiny things. If it’s in a good mood, it might even let its Trainer have a look at its hoard of treasures.

name: Persian
description: Getting this prideful Pokémon to warm up to you takes a lot of effort, and it will claw at you the moment it gets annoyed.

name: Psyduck
description: Always tormented by headaches. It uses psychic powers, but whether it intends to do so is not known.

name: Golduck
description: This Pokémon lives in gently flowing rivers. It paddles through the water with its long limbs, putting its graceful swimming skills on display.

name: Mankey
description: An agile Pokémon that lives in trees. It angers easily and will not hesitate to attack anything.

name: Primeape
description: It stops being angry only when nobody else is around. To view this moment is very difficult.

name: Growlithe
description: They patrol their territory in pairs. I believe the igneous rock components in the fur of this species are the result of volcanic activity in its habitat.

name: Arcanine
description: Snaps at its foes with fangs cloaked in blazing flame. Despite its bulk, it deftly feints every which way, leading opponents on a deceptively merry chase as it all but dances around them.

name: Poliwag
description: In rivers with fast-flowing water, this Pokémon will cling to a rock by using its thick lips, which act like a suction cup.

name: Poliwhirl
description: Under attack, it uses its belly spiral to put the foe to sleep. It then makes its escape.

name: Poliwrath
description: Swims powerfully using all the muscles in its body. It can even overtake world-class swimmers.

name: Abra
description: Sleeps 18 hours a day. If it senses danger, it will teleport itself to safety even as it sleeps.

name: Kadabra
description: Many odd things happen if this Pokémon is close by. For example, it makes clocks run backward.

name: Alakazam
description: A Pokémon that can memorize anything. It never forgets what it learns—that’s why this Pokémon is smart.

name: Machop
description: Always brimming with power, it passes time by lifting boulders. Doing so makes it even stronger.

name: Machoke
description: A sturdy creature boasting a robust physique and boundless stamina. Loves training above all else and voluntarily assists with tasks such as construction and clearing land.

name: Machamp
description: In close combat, its four arms afford it offensive and defensive supremacy. In but a blink, this valiant Pokémon can overwhelm its foes with more than 1,000 blows from its fists.

name: Bellsprout
description: Prefers hot and humid places. It ensnares tiny bugs with its vines and devours them.

name: Weepinbell
description: When hungry, it swallows anything that moves. Its hapless prey is dissolved by strong acids.

name: Victreebel
description: Lures prey with the sweet aroma of honey. Swallowed whole, the prey is dissolved in a day, bones and all.

name: Tentacool
description: They fire beams from the glassy, magenta orbs that resemble eyes atop their heads, and they drift in shallow seas. During low tide, they can sometimes be found on beaches, desiccated.

name: Tentacruel
description: Its 80 tentacles can stretch and contract freely. They wrap around prey and weaken it with poison.

name: Geodude
description: Makes its home in mountainous regions, using its arms to climb along harsh mountain roads. Can be troublesome—carelessly kicking one will cause it to fly into a rage and chase after you.

name: Graveler
description: Dwells in holes dug into sheer walls of stone. It enjoys rolling down slopes as though it were a boulder during a rockfall, so keep an eye upward while traversing mountain roads.

name: Golem
description: The rocklike shell is shed each year. The cast-off shell then crumbles, reverting to a mass of soil, which can be spread across fields to promote crop growth.

name: Ponyta
description: These Pokémon live in herds out in the grassland. Newborn foals lack their fiery manes, which will develop about an hour after birth.

name: Rapidash
description: The fastest runner becomes the leader, and it decides the herd’s pace and direction of travel.

name: Slowpoke
description: Slow-witted and oblivious, this Pokémon won’t feel any pain if its tail gets eaten. It won’t notice when its tail grows back, either.

name: Magnemite
description: A bizarre Pokémon with but a single eye embedded in an iron sphere. I suspect this creature levitates due to the magnetism it emits from its arms, which resemble horseshoe-shaped magnets.

name: Magneton
description: Generates strange radio signals. It raises the temperature by 3.6 degrees Fahrenheit within 3,300 feet.

name: Farfetch’d
description: They use a plant stalk as a weapon, but not all of them use it in the same way. Several distinct styles of stalk fighting have been observed.

name: Doduo
description: Its short wings make flying difficult. Instead, this Pokémon runs at high speed on developed legs.

name: Dodrio
description: An odd species that is rarely found. The three heads respectively represent joy, sadness, and anger.

name: Seel
description: Loves freezing-cold conditions. Relishes swimming in a frigid climate of around 14 degrees Fahrenheit.

name: Dewgong
description: Its entire body is a snowy white. Unharmed by even intense cold, it swims powerfully in icy waters.

name: Grimer
description: Made of congealed sludge. It smells too putrid to touch. Even weeds won’t grow in its path.

name: Muk
description: Smells so awful, it can cause fainting. Through degeneration of its nose, it lost its sense of smell.

name: Shellder
description: Its hard shell repels any kind of attack. It is vulnerable only when its shell is open.

name: Cloyster
description: Once it slams its shell shut, it is impossible to open, even by those with superior strength.

name: Gastly
description: Gaseous and completely impalpable. Also highly dangerous— inhaling part of its poisonous body will cause one to faint instantly.

name: Haunter
description: Its tongue is made of gas. If licked, its victim starts shaking constantly until death eventually comes.

name: Gengar
description: Possesses potential victims' shadows in an effort to steal away the victims' lives. If your shadow begins to laugh, you must take hold of a protective charm posthaste!

name: Onix
description: This chain of immense stones resembles a giant serpent. Tremors shake the earth above as it burrows deep beneath the ground, feeding on boulders as it goes.

name: Drowzee
description: If you sleep by it all the time, it will sometimes show you dreams it had eaten in the past.

name: Hypno
description: Avoid eye contact if you come across one. It will try to put you to sleep by using its pendulum.

name: Krabby
description: If it senses danger approaching, it cloaks itself with bubbles from its mouth so it will look bigger.

name: Kingler
description: Its oversized claw is very powerful, but when it’s not in battle, the claw just gets in the way.

name: Voltorb
description: An enigmatic Pokémon that happens to bear a resemblance to a Poké Ball. When excited, it discharges the electric current it has stored in its belly, then lets out a great, uproarious laugh.

name: Electrode
description: The tissue on the surface of its body is curiously similar in composition to an Apricorn. When irritated, this Pokémon lets loose an electric current equal to 20 lightning bolts.

name: Exeggcute
description: The heads attract each other and spin around. There must be six heads for it to maintain balance.

name: Exeggutor
description: Its cries are very noisy. This is because each of the three heads thinks about whatever it likes.

name: Cubone
description: When the memory of its departed mother brings it to tears, its cries echo mournfully within the skull it wears on its head.

name: Marowak
description: Small and weak, this Pokémon is adept with its bone club. It has grown more vicious over the ages.

name: Hitmonlee
description: The legs freely contract and stretch. The stretchy legs allow it to hit a distant foe with a rising kick.

name: Hitmonchan
description: Its punches slice the air. However, it seems to need a short break after fighting for three minutes.

name: Lickitung
description: Wields its long tongue deftly, as though it were an arm. The Pokémon's viscous saliva, once it has been collected and boiled down, yields a strong and highly useful adhesive.

name: Koffing
description: Its body is full of poisonous gas. It floats into garbage dumps, seeking out the fumes of raw, rotting trash.

name: Weezing
description: It mixes gases between its two bodies. It’s said that these Pokémon were seen all over the Galar region back in the day.

name: Rhyhorn
description: Ludicrously strong—when it butts heads with a mountain, it is the mountain that shatters. But its short legs struggle with turns, and it is incapable of stopping unless it collides with something.

name: Rhydon
description: Rapidly rotates its horn to bore through bedrock. It swaggers around volcanic regions, protected from the lava's heat by its tough, armorlike hide.

name: Chansey
description: This purehearted Pokémon shares its eggs with the injured.

name: Tangela
description: It is cloaked entirely in blue vines, preventing any glimpse of its true identity. The vines impart a refreshing sensation when chewed—they're useful as a spice.

name: Kangaskhan
description: Raises its young in its belly pouch. Won’t run from any fight to keep its young protected.

name: Horsea
description: If it senses any danger, it will vigorously spray water or a special type of ink from its mouth.

name: Seadra
description: Touching the back fin causes numbness. It hooks its tail to coral to stay in place while sleeping.

name: Goldeen
description: Its dorsal and pectoral fins are strongly developed like muscles. It can swim at a speed of five knots.

name: Seaking
description: Using its horn, it bores holes in riverbed boulders, making nests to prevent its eggs from washing away.

name: Staryu
description: As long as the center section is unharmed, this Pokémon can grow back fully even if it is chopped to bits.

name: Starmie
description: The center section is named the core. People think it is communicating when it glows in seven colors.

name: Mr. Mime
description: The behavior of this clown-like Pokémon reminds one of pantomime. It creates invisible walls using a force emitted from its fingertips.

name: Scyther
description: The large, wickedly sharp scythes on its forearms are truly fearsome weapons. Prey's attempts to flee are unfailingly thwarted by this Pokémon's nimble motions.

name: Jynx
description: Appears to move to a rhythm of its own, as if it were dancing. It wiggles its hips as it walks.

name: Electabuzz
description: With the coming of a storm, many of these Pokémon will gather under tall trees and sit there waiting for lightning to strike.

name: Magmar
description: Legend has it that this Pokémon was born from the crater of a volcano. When wounded, it bathes in lava to heal its body, much as one would soak in a hot spring.

name: Pinsir
description: This Pokémon clamps its pincers down on its prey and then either splits the prey in half or flings it away.

name: Tauros
description: A rowdy Pokémon with a lot of stamina. Once running, it won’t stop until it hits something.

name: Magikarp
description: A feeble, pitiful imbecile of a Pokémon that is nonetheless very hardy. Unperturbed by turbid water, it can be found living in all sorts of places.

name: Gyarados
description: I suspect this Pokémon to be the true identity of a dragon written of in ancient texts, which claimed that it razed an entire village with white-hot beams from its maw.

name: Lapras
description: Crossing icy seas is no issue for this cold-resistant Pokémon. Its smooth skin is a little cool to the touch.

name: Ditto
description: It can reconstitute its entire cellular structure to change into what it sees, but it returns to normal when it relaxes.

name: Eevee
description: Thanks to its unstable genetic makeup, this special Pokémon conceals many different possible evolutions.

name: Vaporeon
description: Tests show that its cells closely resemble water molecules, which perhaps explains its ability to conceal its form while submerged. I believe the origins of mermaid folklore lie with this Pokémon.

name: Jolteon
description: Bristles its fur into sharp, needlelike points when enraged. One can hear electricity crackle in its breath when it exhales.

name: Flareon
description: It stores some of the air it inhales in its internal flame pouch, which heats it to over 3,000 degrees Fahrenheit.

name: Porygon
description: It has no discernible heartbeat and does not seem to draw breath, and yet it appears to function without issue. I cannot even begin to explain this utterly bizarre anomaly.

name: Omanyte
description: An ancient Pokémon that was recovered from a fossil. It swam by cleverly twisting its 10 tentacles about.

name: Omastar
description: Its sharp beak rings its mouth. Its shell was too big for it to move freely, so it became extinct.

name: Kabuto
description: A Pokémon that was recovered from a fossil. It used the eyes on its back while hiding on the seafloor.

name: Kabutops
description: A slim and fast swimmer. It sliced its prey with its sharp sickles and drank the body fluids.

name: Aerodactyl
description: This is a ferocious Pokémon from ancient times. Apparently even modern technology is incapable of producing a perfectly restored specimen.

name: Snorlax
description: This glutton appears in villages without warning and devours the entirety of their rice granaries—such occurrences have long been counted among the gravest of disasters.

name: Articuno
description: A legendary bird Pokémon. It freezes water that is contained in winter air and makes it snow.

name: Zapdos
description: This legendary bird Pokémon is said to appear when the sky turns dark and lightning showers down.

name: Moltres
description: There are stories of this Pokémon using its radiant, flame-cloaked wings to light up paths for those lost in the mountains.

name: Dratini
description: Long thought to be a myth, this Pokémon’s existence was only recently confirmed by a fisherman who caught one.

name: Dragonair
description: This Pokémon lives in pristine oceans and lakes. It can control the weather, and it uses this power to fly into the sky, riding on the wind.

name: Dragonite
description: It is said that this Pokémon lives somewhere in the sea and that it flies. However, these are only rumors.

name: Mewtwo
description: It was created by a scientist after years of horrific gene-splicing and DNA-engineering experiments.

name: Mew
description: When viewed through a microscope, this Pokémon’s short, fine, delicate hair can be seen.

name: Chikorita
description: It uses the leaf on its head to determine the temperature and humidity. It loves to sunbathe.

name: Bayleef
description: The buds that ring its neck give off a spicy aroma that perks people up.

name: Meganium
description: The aroma that rises from its petals contains a substance that calms aggressive feelings.

name: Cyndaquil
description: Hails from the Johto region. Though usually curled into a ball due to its timid disposition, it harbors tremendous firepower.

name: Quilava
description: Be careful if it turns its back during battle. It means that it will attack with the fire on its back.

name: Typhlosion
description: Said to purify lost, forsaken souls with its flames and guide them to the afterlife. I believe its form has been influenced by the energy of the sacred mountain towering at Hisui's center.

name: Totodile
description: Its powerful, well-developed jaws are capable of crushing anything. Even its Trainer must be careful.

name: Croconaw
description: Once it bites down, it won’t let go until it loses its fangs. New fangs quickly grow into place.

name: Feraligatr
description: When it bites with its massive and powerful jaws, it shakes its head and savagely tears its victim up.

name: Sentret
description: It stands on its tail so it can see a long way. If it spots an enemy, it cries loudly to warn its kind.

name: Furret
description: It makes a nest to suit its long and skinny body. The nest is impossible for other Pokémon to enter.

name: Hoothoot
description: It begins to hoot at the same time every day. Some Trainers use them in place of clocks.

name: Noctowl
description: When it needs to think, it rotates its head 180 degrees to sharpen its intellectual power.

name: Ledyba
description: These very cowardly Pokémon join together and use Reflect to protect their nest.

name: Ledian
description: It flies through the night sky, sprinkling sparkly dust. According to some, if that dust sticks to you, good things will happen to you.

name: Spinarak
description: Although the poison from its fangs isn’t that strong, it’s potent enough to weaken prey that gets caught in its web.

name: Ariados
description: It spews threads from its mouth to catch its prey. When night falls, it leaves its web to go hunt aggressively.

name: Crobat
description: It feeds on the blood of living people and Pokémon. If it can’t drink any blood for even a short while, it becomes weak and unable to fly.

name: Chinchou
description: On the dark ocean floor, its only means of communication is its constantly flashing lights.

name: Lanturn
description: This Pokémon flashes a bright light that blinds its prey. This creates an opening for it to deliver an electrical attack.

name: Pichu
description: The electric sacs in its cheeks are small. If even a little electricity leaks, it becomes shocked.

name: Cleffa
description: Because of its unusual, starlike silhouette, people believe that it came here on a meteor.

name: Igglybuff
description: Left to its own devices, it will constantly practice singing. You should make it take a break so it doesn’t hurt its throat.

name: Togepi
description: This ovate creature is frequently mistaken for a moving egg when encountered out in the fields or in the mountains. Its guileless smile soothes the soul.

name: Togetic
description: It grows dispirited if it is not with kind people. It can float in midair without moving its wings.

name: Natu
description: Because its wings aren’t yet fully grown, it has to hop to get around. It is always staring at something.

name: Xatu
description: This odd Pokémon can see both the past and the future. It eyes the sun’s movement all day.

name: Mareep
description: Rubbing its fleece generates electricity. You’ll want to pet it because it’s cute, but if you use your bare hand, you’ll get a painful shock.

name: Flaaffy
description: It stores electricity in its fluffy fleece. If it stores up too much, it will start to go bald in those patches.

name: Ampharos
description: Its tail shines bright and strong. It has been prized since long ago as a beacon for sailors.

name: Bellossom
description: Plentiful in the tropics. When it dances, its petals rub together and make a pleasant ringing sound.

name: Marill
description: The tip of its tail is filled with oil that is lighter than water, so it acts as a float.

name: Azumarill
description: The bubble-like pattern on its stomach helps it camouflage itself when it’s in the water.

name: Sudowoodo
description: It disguises itself as a tree to avoid attack. It hates water, so it will disappear if it starts raining.

name: Politoed
description: At nightfall, these Pokémon appear on the shores of lakes. They announce their territorial claims by letting out cries that sound like shouting.

name: Hoppip
description: Its body is so light, it must grip the ground firmly with its feet to keep from being blown away.

name: Skiploom
description: It spreads its petals to absorb sunlight. It also floats in the air to get closer to the sun.

name: Jumpluff
description: Even in the fiercest wind, it can control its fluff to make its way to any place in the world it wants.

name: Aipom
description: This treetop dweller possesses a tail as dexterous as a hand. Ancient writings describe this Pokémon as a one-armed oddity.

name: Sunkern
description: It lives by drinking only dewdrops from under the leaves of plants. It is said that it eats nothing else.

name: Sunflora
description: It gets energy from warm sunlight and is known for its habit of moving in pursuit of it.

name: Yanma
description: Its frail wings are so thin that one can see clear through them. However, during flight these wings exhibit the power to churn air with force enough to launch a house skyward.

name: Wooper
description: When walking on land, it covers its body with a poisonous film that keeps its skin from dehydrating.

name: Quagsire
description: Its body is always slimy. It often bangs its head on the river bottom as it swims but seems not to care.

name: Espeon
description: Wields an arcane power with which it can predict the weather and even people's thoughts. When bathed in sunshine, the scarlet orb on its brow glows and builds energy.

name: Umbreon
description: It is most active in the wee hours of the night, when moonlight bathes the land. Its large eyes can pierce the darkness and perceive prey with absolute clarity.

name: Murkrow
description: Widely shunned as a bearer of ill fortune. Upon crossing paths with this creature, I've been told one must chant ”Workrum, Workrum—bad luck, don't come” as a protective incantation.

name: Slowking
description: It’s constantly coming up with new ideas that would change the world, but as soon as it hits upon a new idea, it forgets it.

name: Misdreavus
description: It conceals itself in darkness, sending chills up travelers' spines with its childlike weeping. As it observes the frightened travelers with glee, the red orbs upon its chest let off an eerie light.

name: Unown
description: It is hard to believe these strangely shaped Pokémon are truly living creatures. I've pointed out that the species' many forms resemble writing from other lands; no one will take me seriously.

name: Wobbuffet
description: To keep its pitch-black tail hidden, it lives quietly in the darkness. It is never first to attack.

name: Girafarig
description: Its tail has a small brain of its own. Beware! If you get close, it may react to your scent by biting.

name: Pineco
description: It looks just like a pinecone. Its shell protects it from bird Pokémon that peck it by mistake.

name: Forretress
description: In the moment that it gulps down its prey, the inside of its shell is exposed, but to this day, no one has ever seen that sight.

name: Dunsparce
description: When it sees a person, it digs a hole with its tail to make its escape. If you happen to find one, consider yourself lucky.

name: Gligar
description: Its tail is tipped by a thick, horrible stinger. To bring down prey, it will first obscure their vision by covering their faces with its body, and then it will use the stinger to inject them with venom.

name: Steelix
description: This Pokémon evolved through use of a strange item. Its body is coated with steel powder and notably hard—not even diamond can leave so much as a scratch.

name: Snubbull
description: In contrast to its appearance, it’s quite timid. When playing with other puppy Pokémon, it sometimes gets bullied.

name: Granbull
description: While it has powerful jaws, it doesn’t care for disputes, so it rarely has a chance to display their might.

name: Qwilfish
description: The small spikes covering its body developed from scales. They inject a toxin that causes fainting.

name: Scizor
description: Evolved by way of a curious item. The shell covering its body has been shown to be stronger than forged steel.

name: Shuckle
description: The berries stored in its vaselike shell eventually become a thick, pulpy juice.

name: Heracross
description: This Pokémon takes pride in its strength, which allows it to lift things 100 times heavier than itself with no trouble at all.

name: Sneasel
description: It has a cunning yet savage disposition. It waits for parents to leave their nests, and then it sneaks in to steal their eggs.

name: Teddiursa
description: Before food becomes scarce in wintertime, its habit is to hoard food in many hidden locations.

name: Ursaring
description: Although it has a large body, it is quite skilled at climbing trees. It eats and sleeps in the treetops.

name: Slugma
description: Its body is made of magma. If it doesn’t keep moving, its body will cool and harden.

name: Magcargo
description: Its body is as hot as lava and is always billowing. Flames will occasionally burst from its shell.

name: Swinub
description: If it smells something enticing, it dashes off headlong to find the source of the aroma.

name: Piloswine
description: Although its legs are short, its rugged hooves prevent it from slipping, even on icy ground.

name: Corsola
description: These Pokémon live in warm seas. In prehistoric times, many lived in the oceans around the Galar region as well.

name: Remoraid
description: The water they shoot from their mouths can hit moving prey from more than 300 feet away.

name: Octillery
description: It traps enemies with its suction-cupped tentacles, then smashes them with its rock-hard head.

name: Delibird
description: It has a generous habit of sharing its food with people and Pokémon, so it’s always scrounging around for more food.

name: Mantine
description: This calm and gentle Pokémon swims gracefully through the sea. After building speed, it can leap out of the water. It is often misidentified as a bird Pokémon due to this behavior.

name: Skarmory
description: Its body is draped in steel armor. It looks heavy, but it can fly at speeds of up to 185 miles an hour!

name: Houndour
description: They make repeated eerie howls before dawn to call attention to their pack.

name: Houndoom
description: Identifiable by its eerie howls, people a long time ago thought it was the grim reaper and feared it.

name: Kingdra
description: Scales shed by this Pokémon have such a splendorous gleam to them that they’ve been given to royalty as gifts.

name: Phanpy
description: It is strong despite its compact size. It can easily pick up and carry an adult human on its back.

name: Donphan
description: The longer and bigger its tusks, the higher its rank in its herd. The tusks take long to grow.

name: Porygon2
description: A bizarre item caused this Pokémon to evolve. While it now exhibits many new gestures and expressions, its biology remains inscrutable.

name: Stantler
description: Its strangely shaped antlers have the power to bewitch those who see them. Medicine made by grinding up the black orbs from fallen antlers is an effective treatment for insomnia.

name: Smeargle
description: Once it becomes an adult, it has a tendency to let its comrades plant footprints on its back.

name: Tyrogue
description: Even though it is small, it can’t be ignored because it will slug any handy target without warning.

name: Hitmontop
description: After doing a handstand to throw off the opponent’s timing, it presents its fancy kick moves.

name: Smoochum
description: When it examines things, before touching them with its hands, it makes lip contact and then diligently licks all the dirt off its lips.

name: Elekid
description: It’s not good at storing electricity yet. This Pokémon sneaks into people’s homes, looking for electrical outlets to eat electricity from.

name: Magby
description: When flames drip from its nose, that means it has a cold. Have it lie down for a nice rest in some magma.

name: Miltank
description: Its milk is delicious and chock-full of nutrients. However, if you drink too much, it could make your stomach hurt, so be careful.

name: Blissey
description: A kindhearted Pokémon that will care for any sick person or Pokémon until their health improves. The eggs it lays are delicious and bring good fortune to those who eat them.

name: Raikou
description: This rough Pokémon stores energy inside its body, then sweeps across the land, shooting off electricity.

name: Entei
description: It is said that when it roars, a volcano erupts somewhere around the globe.

name: Suicune
description: Said to be the embodiment of north winds, it can instantly purify filthy, murky water.

name: Larvitar
description: It feeds on soil. After it has eaten a large mountain, it will fall asleep so it can grow.

name: Pupitar
description: It will not stay still, even while it’s a pupa. It already has arms and legs under its solid shell.

name: Tyranitar
description: The quakes caused when it walks make even great mountains crumble and change the surrounding terrain.

name: Lugia
description: It is said to be the guardian of the seas. It is rumored to have been seen on the night of a storm.

name: Ho-Oh
description: It will reveal itself before a pure-hearted Trainer by shining its bright, rainbow-colored wings.

name: Celebi
description: This Pokémon traveled through time to come from the future. It bolsters grass and trees with its own strength, and it can heal wounds, too.

name: Treecko
description: Small hooks on the bottom of its feet catch on walls and ceilings. That is how it can hang from above.

name: Grovyle
description: It lives in dense jungles. While closing in on its prey, it leaps from branch to branch.

name: Sceptile
description: It agilely leaps about the jungle and uses the sharp leaves on its arms to strike its prey.

name: Torchic
description: A fire burns inside, so it feels very warm to hug. It launches fireballs of 1,800 degrees Fahrenheit.

name: Combusken
description: During a battle, the hot flame in its body increases. Its kicks have outstanding destructive power.

name: Blaziken
description: When facing a tough foe, it looses flames from its wrists. Its powerful legs let it jump clear over buildings.

name: Mudkip
description: To alert it, the fin on its head senses the flow of water. It has the strength to heft boulders.

name: Marshtomp
description: Living on muddy ground that provides poor footing has made its legs sturdy.

name: Swampert
description: It can swim while towing a large ship. It bashes down foes with a swing of its thick arms.

name: Poochyena
description: It has a very tenacious nature. Its acute sense of smell lets it chase a chosen prey without ever losing track.

name: Mightyena
description: It chases down prey in a pack of around ten. They defeat foes with perfectly coordinated teamwork.

name: Zigzagoon
description: A Pokémon with abundant curiosity. It shows an interest in everything, so it always zigzags.

name: Linoone
description: It uses its explosive speed and razor-sharp claws to bring down prey. Running along winding paths is not its strong suit.

name: Wurmple
description: It lives among the tall grass and in forests. It repels attacks by raising up the spikes on its rear.

name: Silcoon
description: It drinks dew that collects on its silk and waits for evolution. Its hard cocoon repels attacks.

name: Beautifly
description: It has an aggressive nature. It stabs prey with its long, narrow mouth to drain the prey’s fluids.

name: Cascoon
description: It never forgets any attack it endured while in the cocoon. After evolution, it seeks payback.

name: Dustox
description: Tends to be drawn to bonfires on dark nights. Difficult to chase away from settlements because of the way it scatters highly toxic scales.

name: Lotad
description: Its leaf grew too large for it to live on land. That is how it began to live floating in the water.

name: Lombre
description: It lives at the water’s edge where it is sunny. It sleeps on a bed of water grass by day and becomes active at night.

name: Ludicolo
description: If it hears festive music, it begins moving in rhythm in order to amplify its power.

name: Seedot
description: It attaches itself to a tree branch using the top of its head. Strong winds can sometimes make it fall.

name: Nuzleaf
description: It lives deep in forests. With the leaf on its head, it makes a flute whose song makes listeners uneasy.

name: Shiftry
description: It lives quietly in the deep forest. It is said to create chilly winter winds with the fans it holds.

name: Taillow
description: It dislikes cold seasons. They migrate to other lands in search of warmth, flying over 180 miles a day.

name: Swellow
description: It dives at a steep angle as soon as it spots its prey. It catches its prey with sharp claws.

name: Wingull
description: It soars on updrafts without flapping its wings. It makes a nest on sheer cliffs at the sea’s edge.

name: Pelipper
description: Skimming the water’s surface, it dips its large bill in the sea, scoops up food and water, and carries it.

name: Ralts
description: Tends to prefer people with a chipper disposition to those who are gloomy, but it has shown no discrimination with regard to age or gender. Needs more research.

name: Kirlia
description: It resembles a maiden in appearance, but it wields strange powers to project visions of paradise. I suspect the crimson ornaments on its head are the key to its abilities.

name: Gardevoir
description: It will dedicate itself to defending a master it has come to adore. Its pure white dress, reminiscent of those worn by ladies of nobility, is the dress of one who is willing to risk their life.

name: Surskit
description: If it’s in a pinch, it will secrete a sweet liquid from the tip of its head. Syrup made from gathering that liquid is tasty on bread.

name: Masquerain
description: Its thin, winglike antennae are highly absorbent. It waits out rainy days in tree hollows.

name: Shroomish
description: It spouts poison spores from the top of its head. These spores cause pain all over if inhaled.

name: Breloom
description: It scatters poisonous spores and throws powerful punches while its foe is hampered by inhaled spores.

name: Slakoth
description: If it eats just three leaves in a day, it is satisfied. Other than that, it sleeps for 20 hours a day.

name: Vigoroth
description: Its stress level rises if it cannot keep moving constantly. Too much stress makes it feel sick.

name: Slaking
description: It is the world’s most slothful Pokémon. However, it can exert horrifying power by releasing pent-up energy all at once.

name: Nincada
description: It can sometimes live underground for more than 10 years. It absorbs nutrients from the roots of trees.

name: Ninjask
description: This Pokémon is so quick, it is said to be able to avoid any attack. It loves to feed on tree sap.

name: Shedinja
description: A strange Pokémon—it flies without moving its wings, has a hollow shell for a body, and does not breathe.

name: Whismur
description: If it senses danger, it scares the foe by crying out with the volume of a jet-plane engine.

name: Loudred
description: The force of this Pokémon’s loud voice isn’t just the sound—it’s also the wave of air pressure that blows opponents away and damages them.

name: Exploud
description: This Pokémon can do more than just shout. To communicate with others of its kind, it’ll emit all sorts of sounds from the holes in its body.

name: Makuhita
description: Their daily routine consists of training together first thing in the morning, eating and napping in the afternoon, and then more training afterward.

name: Hariyama
description: Although they enjoy comparing their strength, they’re also kind. They value etiquette, praising opponents they battle.

name: Azurill
description: It swings its large, nutrient-filled tail around to fight opponents bigger than itself.

name: Nosepass
description: Once the people of Hisui discovered that its red nose always points north, they grew to rely on it greatly when traveling afar. The nose seems to work in a similar way to ancient compasses.

name: Skitty
description: It shows its cute side by chasing its own tail until it gets dizzy.

name: Delcatty
description: It is highly popular among female Trainers for its sublime fur. It does not keep a nest.

name: Sableye
description: It feeds on gemstone crystals. In darkness, its eyes sparkle with the glitter of jewels.

name: Mawile
description: It chomps with its gaping mouth. Its huge jaws are actually steel horns that have been transformed.

name: Aron
description: It eats iron ore—and sometimes railroad tracks— to build up the steel armor that protects its body.

name: Lairon
description: It habitually shows off its strength with the size of sparks it creates by ramming its steel body into boulders.

name: Aggron
description: While seeking iron for food, it digs tunnels by breaking through bedrock with its steel horns.

name: Meditite
description: It eats just one berry a day. By enduring hunger, its spirit is tempered and made sharper.

name: Medicham
description: Through yoga training, it gained the psychic power to predict its foe’s next move.

name: Electrike
description: It stores electricity in its fur. It gives off sparks from all over its body in seasons when the air is dry.

name: Manectric
description: It rarely appears before people. It is said to nest where lightning has fallen.

name: Plusle
description: It absorbs electricity from telephone poles. It shorts out its body to create crackling noises.

name: Minun
description: It cheers on friends. If its friends are losing, its body lets off more and more sparks.

name: Volbeat
description: It lives around clean ponds. At night, its rear lights up. It converses with others by flashing its light.

name: Roselia
description: Though beautiful, it has highly poisonous thorns. There is an old tradition in my homeland wherein one would send these thorns to an opponent to challenge them to a duel.

name: Gulpin
description: There is nothing its stomach can’t digest. While it is digesting, vile, overpowering gases are expelled.

name: Swalot
description: It gulps anything that fits in its mouth. Its special enzymes can dissolve anything.

name: Carvanha
description: They’re such cowards that they won’t hunt alone. When five or so of them get together, they suddenly turn ferocious!

name: Sharpedo
description: It drinks in seawater and jets it from its rear to propel itself. It’s very sensitive to the scent of blood.

name: Wailmer
description: When it sucks in a large volume of seawater, it becomes like a big, bouncy ball. It eats a ton of food daily.

name: Wailord
description: It can sometimes knock out opponents with the shock created by breaching and crashing its big body onto the water.

name: Numel
description: The magma in its body reaches 2,200 degrees Fahrenheit. Its hump gets smaller when it uses Fire-type moves.

name: Camerupt
description: If angered, the humps on its back erupt in a shower of molten lava. It lives in the craters of volcanoes.

name: Torkoal
description: You find abandoned coal mines full of them. They dig tirelessly in search of coal.

name: Spoink
description: It bounces constantly, using its tail like a spring. The shock of bouncing keeps its heart beating.

name: Grumpig
description: It uses black pearls to amplify its psychic power. It does an odd dance to gain control over foes.

name: Spinda
description: Its steps are shaky and stumbling. Walking for a long time makes it feel sick.

name: Trapinch
description: It makes an inescapable conical pit and lies in wait at the bottom for prey to come tumbling down.

name: Vibrava
description: To help make its wings grow, it dissolves quantities of prey in its digestive juices and guzzles them down every day.

name: Flygon
description: It is nicknamed the Desert Spirit because the flapping of its wings sounds like a woman singing.

name: Cacnea
description: It prefers harsh environments such as deserts. It can survive for 30 days on water stored in its body.

name: Cacturne
description: Packs of them follow travelers through the desert until the travelers can no longer move.

name: Swablu
description: It constantly grooms its cotton-like wings. It takes a shower to clean itself if it becomes dirty.

name: Altaria
description: This Pokémon has a kind disposition, but if it’s provoked, it will threaten opponents with shrill cries before attacking them without mercy.

name: Seviper
description: It sharpens its swordlike tail on hard rocks. It hides in tall grass and strikes unwary prey with venomous fangs.

name: Lunatone
description: It was discovered at the site of a meteor strike 40 years ago. Its stare can lull its foes to sleep.

name: Solrock
description: Solar energy is the source of its power, so it is strong during the daytime. When it spins, its body shines.

name: Barboach
description: Makes its home in swamps with murky water. The poor visibility hides this Pokémon from predators, and the slime on its body makes grasping it difficult.

name: Whiscash
description: Strikes its caudal fin against the swamp bed to shake the ground and startle its prey. It will then swallow the fleeing prey whole. People mistook this behavior as the cause of earthquakes.

name: Corphish
description: It was originally a Pokémon from afar that escaped to the wild. It can adapt to the dirtiest river.

name: Crawdaunt
description: A brutish Pokémon that loves to battle. It will crash itself into any foe that approaches its nest.

name: Baltoy
description: It was discovered in ancient ruins. While moving, it constantly spins. It stands on one foot even when asleep.

name: Claydol
description: It appears to have been born from clay dolls made by ancient people. It uses telekinesis to float and move.

name: Lileep
description: It sticks to rocks with its powerful suckers and can’t be washed away no matter how rough the surf gets.

name: Cradily
description: It has short legs and can’t walk very fast, but its neck and tentacles can extend to over three times their usual length to nab distant prey.

name: Anorith
description: This is one kind of primeval bug Pokémon. With eight wings, it could apparently swim a lot faster than you’d expect.

name: Armaldo
description: Though it lives on land, it’s also a good swimmer. It dives into the ocean in search of prey, using its sharp claws to take down its quarry.

name: Feebas
description: It is a shabby and ugly Pokémon. However, it is very hardy and can survive on little water.

name: Milotic
description: Its dwelling place is the bottom of big lakes. Those who behold its loveliness are said to have their hearts purified.

name: Castform
description: Although its form changes with the weather, that is apparently the result of a chemical reaction and not the result of its own free will.

name: Kecleon
description: Its color changes for concealment and also when its mood or health changes. The darker the color, the healthier it is.

name: Shuppet
description: It eats up emotions like malice, jealousy, and resentment, so some people are grateful for its presence.

name: Banette
description: Resentment at being cast off made it spring into being. Some say that treating it well will satisfy it, and it will once more become a stuffed toy.

name: Duskull
description: I've heard that the children of Hisui all begin to behave once they've been told the story of how this Pokémon roams about before the witching hour to spirit away misbehaving children.

name: Dusclops
description: There are rumors that peeking inside its bandage-wrapped body will cause one to get pulled in through the gaps between the bandages, never to return. I've been too scared to verify.

name: Tropius
description: The bunch of fruit around its neck ripens twice a year and is delicious. It’s a highly favored tropical snack.

name: Chimecho
description: Can emit waves of air powerful enough to knock out prey taller than itself. I hypothesize that it amplifies the faint sound of wind within its body.

name: Absol
description: The elderly call it the disaster Pokémon and detest it, but interest in its power to predict disasters is on the rise.

name: Wynaut
description: It tends to move in a pack with others. They cluster in a tight group to sleep in a cave.

name: Snorunt
description: It can only survive in cold areas. It bounces happily around, even in environments as cold as −150 degrees Fahrenheit.

name: Glalie
description: It covers its body with an armor of ice harder than steel. Uses its breath to freeze prey, which it then devours as if they were frozen desserts.

name: Spheal
description: Its body is covered in fluffy fur. The fur keeps it from feeling cold while it is rolling on ice.

name: Sealeo
description: It has a very sensitive nose. It touches new things with its nose to examine them.

name: Walrein
description: Its thick tusks are strong enough to shatter drift ice. They have been known to break, but they will grow back by the next year. The Hisui region is well known for these broken tusks.

name: Clamperl
description: Despite its appearance, it’s carnivorous. It clamps down on its prey with both sides of its shell and doesn’t let go until they stop moving.

name: Huntail
description: It’s not the strongest swimmer. It wags its tail to lure in its prey and then gulps them down as soon as they get close.

name: Gorebyss
description: It sucks bodily fluids out of its prey. The leftover meat sinks to the seafloor, where it becomes food for other Pokémon.

name: Relicanth
description: This Pokémon was discovered during deep-sea exploration. Its appearance hasn’t changed in 100,000,000 years, so it’s called a living fossil.

name: Luvdisc
description: There was an era when it was overfished due to the rumor that having one of its heart-shaped scales would enable you to find a sweetheart.

name: Bagon
description: Some theories suggest that its behavior of forcefully bashing its head into things stimulates cells that affect its evolution.

name: Shelgon
description: The cells within its body are changing at a bewildering pace. Its hard shell is made from the same substance as bone.

name: Salamence
description: Thanks to its fervent wishes, the cells in its body finally mutated, and at last it has its heart’s desire—wings.

name: Beldum
description: If you anger it, it will do more than rampage. It will also burst out strong magnetism, causing nearby machines to break.

name: Metang
description: Using magnetic forces to stay aloft, this Pokémon flies at high speeds, weaving through harsh mountain terrain in pursuit of prey.

name: Metagross
description: It analyzes its opponents with more accuracy than a supercomputer, which enables it to calmly back them into a corner.

name: Regirock
description: Cutting-edge technology was used to study the internals of this Pokémon’s rock body, but nothing was found—not even a brain or a heart.

name: Regice
description: Its body is made of ice from the ice age. It controls frigid air of -328 degrees Fahrenheit.

name: Registeel
description: It’s rumored that this Pokémon was born deep underground in the planet’s mantle and that it emerged onto the surface 10,000 years ago.

name: Latias
description: It can telepathically communicate with people. It changes its appearance using its down that refracts light.

name: Latios
description: It understands human speech and is highly intelligent. It is a tender Pokémon that dislikes fighting.

name: Kyogre
description: Through Primal Reversion and with nature’s full power, it will take back its true form. It can summon storms that cause the sea levels to rise.

name: Groudon
description: Through Primal Reversion and with nature’s full power, it will take back its true form. It can cause magma to erupt and expand the landmass of the world.

name: Rayquaza
description: It flies forever through the ozone layer, consuming meteoroids for sustenance. The many meteoroids in its body provide the energy it needs to Mega Evolve.

name: Jirachi
description: It’s believed that when this Pokémon wakes from its 1,000-year slumber, it will grant any wishes written on the notes attached to its head.

name: Deoxys
description: DNA from a space virus mutated and became a Pokémon. It appears where auroras are seen.

name: Turtwig
description: This Pokémon becomes more energetic the more sunlight there is. The part resembling a shell is similar to silt and is slightly damp and warm to the touch.

name: Grotle
description: Appears where there is clean spring water. The fruit that grows on the shrubs on its shell is sweet, nutritious, and truly delicious.

name: Torterra
description: Small Pokémon occasionally gather on its unmoving back to begin building their nests.

name: Chimchar
description: Full of vigor and always in high spirits. It was once known by the name ”Lantern-Tail” and feared as some kind of apparition.

name: Monferno
description: The deeper the blue on its face, the more powerful it will grow to become. It leaps about every which way and lands powerful blows against its opponents with the flame on its tail.

name: Infernape
description: A tall, hardy Pokémon with a dazzling appearance. It shrouds itself in flame and battles as if engaged in dance—truly a sight to behold.

name: Piplup
description: Prefers cold climes and appears along coasts. It's an adorable little thing—as cute as any child—but it's also prideful, unwilling to accept handouts from people.

name: Prinplup
description: It swims gracefully through the frigid sea and sings with a voice like the roaring tide. It has powerful, sturdy wings and dignity to match.

name: Empoleon
description: Since ancient times, it has been revered by the people of Hisui, who call it the Master of the Waves. Its wings are a match for even master-crafted blades.

name: Starly
description: They live in the fields and mountains, gathering in large flocks. Their cries are quite obnoxious. Though small, their wings are strong—a strike from them leaves pain that persists for a week.

name: Staravia
description: They form remarkably large flocks and are constantly fighting amongst themselves. I suspect that those with magnificent plumes on their heads are the strong ones.

name: Staraptor
description: The muscles in its wings and legs are strong. It can easily fly while gripping a small Pokémon.

name: Bidoof
description: It constantly gnaws on logs and rocks to whittle down its front teeth. It nests alongside water.

name: Bibarel
description: It makes its nest by damming streams with bark and mud. It is known as an industrious worker.

name: Kricketot
description: When the trees take on new hues, more of these Pokémon appear. The tone they create by striking their antennae together resembles that of the marimba, an instrument of foreign lands.

name: Kricketune
description: It uses its cutlass-like arms to produce sound, the melody of which varies from individual to individual. It is a worthwhile endeavor to seek out one's favorite tunes.

name: Shinx
description: Shakes its body to generate electricity. Its stature belies its aggression—one must be patient to tame this Pokémon.

name: Luxio
description: Proudly uses its electrified claws as weapons. It seems to be a gracious Pokémon, evenly sharing the spoils of the hunt with others of its kind.

name: Luxray
description: When its eyes gleam gold, it can spot hiding prey—even those taking shelter behind a wall.

name: Budew
description: When the sun's light strengthens, the bud atop this Pokémon's head opens. This is a sign to the people that the harsh winter is over, and the season of budding has begun.

name: Roserade
description: The poison in its right hand is quick acting. The poison in its left hand is slow acting. Both are life threatening.

name: Cranidos
description: An incredibly rare sight. They duel each other by ramming their heads together, and the resulting sound echoes throughout the area like the pealing of a bell.

name: Rampardos
description: Very little is known about its biology. Can knock down massive trees by smashing its beautiful, pearl-like crown against them.

name: Shieldon
description: Much remains unknown about this Pokémon, as few have ever seen it. However, we know that it is calm and dislikes conflict, and it enjoys polishing its face against trees and rocks.

name: Bastiodon
description: Its face is sturdy—as strong as diamond—and this hardness offers a very stable defense. Much about this species is still unknown, such as its natural habitat.

name: Burmy
description: If its cloak is broken in battle, it quickly remakes the cloak with materials nearby.

name: Wormadam
description: Its appearance changes depending on where it evolved. The materials on hand become a part of its body.

name: Mothim
description: It does not keep a nest. It flies over fields and mountains in constant search of floral honey.

name: Combee
description: They swear fealty to a queen Pokémon and work diligently to gather nectar. Each swarm produces a different flavor of honey.

name: Vespiquen
description: Commands its subjects to build its hive. It will dispatch any interlopers who dare sneak into its nest and use them as nourishment for itself.

name: Pachirisu
description: A pair may be seen rubbing their cheek pouches together in an effort to share stored electricity.

name: Buizel
description: It moves freely in the water by spinning its forked tail for propulsion. The resemblance to the screw of a steamboat is coincidental.

name: Floatzel
description: Its flotation sac developed as a result of pursuing aquatic prey. It can double as a rubber raft.

name: Cherubi
description: It nimbly dashes about to avoid getting pecked by bird Pokémon that would love to make off with its small, nutrient-rich storage ball.

name: Cherrim
description: As a bud, it barely moves. It sits still, placidly waiting for sunlight to appear.

name: Shellos
description: Subjecting this Pokémon to a strong force causes it to secrete a strange purple fluid. Though harmless, the fluid is awfully sticky.

name: Gastrodon
description: The softness of its body helps disperse the force of impacts, so although its body is uncommonly squishy, it’s also surprisingly resilient.

name: Ambipom
description: To affirm their kinship, members of this species will form a ring by linking their newly doubled tails together. On rare occasions, humans have been accepted into such rings.

name: Drifloon
description: The gathering of many souls gave rise to this Pokémon. During humid seasons, they seem to appear in abundance.

name: Drifblim
description: It grabs people and Pokémon and carries them off somewhere. Where do they go? Nobody knows.

name: Buneary
description: The reason it keeps one ear rolled up is so it can launch a swift counterattack if it’s attacked by an enemy.

name: Lopunny
description: Its fur is warm and yet remarkably light. This Pokémon kicks as though it were a master of karate, driving back its opponents with ease.

name: Mismagius
description: Its muttered curses can cause awful headaches or terrifying visions that torment others.

name: Honchkrow
description: Its goons take care of most of the fighting for it. The only time it dirties its own hands is in delivering a final blow to finish off an opponent.

name: Glameow
description: Bewitches humans with its helical tail and piercing gaze. Its hidden claws are quite sharp as well, making this Pokémon an exceedingly tricky opponent if antagonized.

name: Purugly
description: To make itself appear intimidatingly beefy, it tightly cinches its waist with its twin tails.

name: Chingling
description: This Pokémon gave me an excruciating headache when it seemingly cried out without making a sound. Perhaps there are some sounds that the human ear is simply incapable of hearing.

name: Stunky
description: The poison that gushes from its aft end is accompanied by an utterly evil-smelling odor with such potency that one whiff can induce memory loss.

name: Skuntank
description: Sprays a poisonous fluid to take down prey. Sometimes, unable to stomach the stench of its own fluid, it leaves the bested prey uneaten.

name: Bronzor
description: Floats using a mysterious energy. The pattern engraved upon its back is held as sacred and can sometimes be found in imagery from ancient cemeteries and other such timeworn places.

name: Bronzong
description: Some believe that its bell-like cry opens holes to another world. It has been revered as a deity since ancient times.

name: Bonsly
description: Its tears elicit sympathy from those who see them, but do not be deceived! This expulsion of body water is merely a physiological mechanism for keeping itself in good health.

name: Mime Jr.
description: Known to turn up in bustling marketplaces now and again. It mimics people much as a child would, then watches how they react, eyes sparkling.

name: Happiny
description: Usually it’s a well-behaved Pokémon, but if you take its round rock away, it will cry and fuss and throw a big old tantrum.

name: Chatot
description: It can learn and speak human words. If they gather, they all learn the same saying.

name: Spiritomb
description: It lays curses by thinking wicked thoughts. Writings tell that this Pokémon was born out of the assembly of five score and eight malevolent spirits.

name: Gible
description: It nests in caves untouched by sunlight. Its sharp teeth may fall out when worn away or after an impact, but they regrow within a few days.

name: Gabite
description: Jewels are buried in the caves these Pokémon nest in, but you’ll be torn apart by claws and fangs the moment you enter one of these caves.

name: Garchomp
description: Its fine scales don’t just reduce wind resistance—their sharp edges also cause injury to any opponent who attacks it.

name: Munchlax
description: Its robust stomach allows it to nonchalantly devour even rotted matter. It pays frequent visits to villages, seeking out food scraps intended for compost.

name: Riolu
description: It can use waves called auras to gauge how others are feeling. These same waves can also tell this Pokémon about the state of the environment.

name: Lucario
description: A most gallant-looking creature. It emits energy waves and controls them with precision, using them to sense even faraway beings. I have given the name ”aura” to this power.

name: Hippopotas
description: This Pokémon is active during the day and passes the cold desert nights burrowed snugly into the sand.

name: Hippowdon
description: Short-tempered and easily moved to violence. It whips up whirlwinds of sand to crush its foes' spirits, then goes in for the attack.

name: Skorupi
description: It attacks using the claws on its tail. Once locked in its grip, its prey is unable to move as this Pokémon’s poison seeps in.

name: Drapion
description: Has a brutish, ferocious temperament. With immense strength and a sturdy shell off which swords will bounce, it rampages about and wreaks havoc.

name: Croagunk
description: A poison wielder with a dastardly personality. Despite such qualities, this species is afforded a measure of popularity due to its peculiar cry and comical features.

name: Toxicroak
description: Its crimson claws contain a virulent toxin. This toxin can be made into a tonic by diluting it, mixing it with several types of wild grass, and boiling it down over two days.

name: Carnivine
description: It binds itself to trees in marshes. It attracts prey with its sweet-smelling drool and gulps them down.

name: Finneon
description: It lures in prey with its shining tail fins. It stays near the surface during the day and moves to the depths when night falls.

name: Lumineon
description: They traverse the deep waters as if crawling over the seafloor. The fantastic lights of its fins shine like stars in the night sky.

name: Mantyke
description: When it swims close to the surface of the ocean, people aboard ships are able to observe the pattern on its back.

name: Snover
description: It lives on snowy mountains. It sinks its legs into the snow to absorb water and keep its own temperature down.

name: Abomasnow
description: A powerful Pokémon that can split huge boulders with ease. Dislikes associating with others and chooses to live quietly deep within the mountains, playing with the snow.

name: Weavile
description: With its claws, it leaves behind signs for its friends to find. The number of distinct signs is said to be over 500.

name: Magnezone
description: I theorize that a special magnetic field influenced this Pokémon, changing its molecular structure and causing it to evolve. It emits strange radio waves toward space from its antenna.

name: Lickilicky
description: It uses its tongue much more skillfully than its hands or its feet. It can deftly pick up a single small bean with its tongue.

name: Rhyperior
description: This Pokémon evolved through use of a curious item. Its rocklike hide is composed of a mysterious substance and can withstand a blow from a masterwork sword with nary a scratch.

name: Tangrowth
description: Draped with long vines, it resembles a shrub in appearance. It swings bundles of vines as though they were arms, wrapping them around prey to ensnare them.

name: Electivire
description: Its evolution was induced by an unusual item, and its electrical output rises along with its heart rate. From its tails, it can unleash an electric current measuring 20,000 volts.

name: Magmortar
description: Use of a strange item caused this Pokémon to evolve. Fireballs launched from the ends of its tubelike arms are hot enough to melt an iron pot in an instant.

name: Togekiss
description: Known as a bringer of blessings, it’s been depicted on good-luck charms since ancient times.

name: Yanmega
description: Extremely violent. When hunting, it wastes none of its energy, aiming only for prey's most vulnerable spots. Any who manage to tame this Pokémon must be of incredible bravery.

name: Leafeon
description: Cells similar to those of plants have been found in its fur. Its hard tail can fell a large tree with one stroke, and the tail's sharpness exceeds even that of a sword crafted by a master.

name: Glaceon
description: It can instantaneously freeze any moisture that’s around it, creating ice pellets to shoot at its prey.

name: Gliscor
description: It glides soundlessly on pitch-black wings and sinks sharp fangs into the throat of its prey. It takes on a look of satisfaction once it has entirely drained its prey of blood.

name: Mamoswine
description: It looks strong, and that’s exactly what it is. As the weather grows colder, its ice tusks grow longer, thicker, and more impressive.

name: Porygon-Z
description: A curious item induced this evolution. The Pokémon's offensive capabilities have greatly increased, but the strangeness of its behavior has magnified in equal measure. This worries me.

name: Gallade
description: The blades extending from its elbows are sharper than the finest swords. Its swordsmanship, albeit self-taught, is astonishingly impressive.

name: Probopass
description: It uses three small units to catch prey and battle enemies. The main body mostly just gives orders.

name: Dusknoir
description: Comes to those whose lives have come to an end and escorts their souls to the afterlife. Known to mistakenly take the souls of those who yet have life left in them, albeit rarely.

name: Froslass
description: It spits out cold air of nearly −60 degrees Fahrenheit to freeze its quarry. It brings frozen prey back to its lair and neatly lines them up.

name: Rotom
description: With a body made of plasma, it can inhabit all sorts of machines. It loves to surprise others.

name: Uxie
description: It is said that its emergence gave humans the intelligence to improve their quality of life.

name: Mesprit
description: Known as the Being of Emotion. In legend, this Pokémon was feared, as any who showed disrespect would have their emotions thrown into disarray.

name: Azelf
description: The dreaded Being of Willpower. Legends tell of this Pokémon manipulating the will of its adversaries and turning them into puppets of its own.

name: Dialga
description: It has the power to control time. It appears in Sinnoh-region myths as an ancient deity.

name: Palkia
description: It has the ability to distort space. It is described as a deity in Sinnoh-region mythology.

name: Heatran
description: Stories tell of this Pokémon being birthed from the boiling magma within Mount Coronet. Its molten-steel body holds many mysteries.

name: Regigigas
description: There is an enduring legend that states this Pokémon towed continents with ropes.

name: Giratina
description: It was banished for its violence. It silently gazed upon the old world from the Distortion World.

name: Cresselia
description: Shiny particles are released from its wings like a veil. It is said to represent the crescent moon.

name: Phione
description: Can be seen floating offshore during seasons when the seas are warm. Its azure body blends in with the ocean waters—logic suggests this is a defense mechanism against natural predators.

name: Manaphy
description: It starts its life with a wondrous power that permits it to bond with any kind of Pokémon.

name: Darkrai
description: It can lull people to sleep and make them dream. It is active during nights of the new moon.

name: Shaymin
description: The blooming of Gracidea flowers confers the power of flight upon it. Feelings of gratitude are the message it delivers.

name: Arceus
description: It is told in mythology that this Pokémon was born before the universe even existed.

name: Victini
description: When it shares the infinite energy it creates, that being’s entire body will be overflowing with power.

name: Snivy
description: They photosynthesize by bathing their tails in sunlight. When they are not feeling well, their tails droop.

name: Servine
description: When it gets dirty, its leaves can’t be used in photosynthesis, so it always keeps itself clean.

name: Serperior
description: It can stop its opponents’ movements with just a glare. It takes in solar energy and boosts it internally.

name: Tepig
description: It loves to eat roasted berries, but sometimes it gets too excited and burns them to a crisp.

name: Pignite
description: When its internal fire flares up, its movements grow sharper and faster. When in trouble, it emits smoke.

name: Emboar
description: It has mastered fast and powerful fighting moves. It grows a beard of fire.

name: Oshawott
description: This Pokémon from the Unova region uses the shell on its belly as a weapon to cut down its foes. Thus, I've conferred upon this shell the name ”scalchop”.

name: Dewott
description: Its exquisite double-scalchop technique is likely the result of daily training, and it can send even masters of the blade fleeing in defeat.

name: Samurott
description: One swing of the sword incorporated in its armor can fell an opponent. A simple glare from one of them quiets everybody.

name: Patrat
description: Extremely cautious, one of them will always be on the lookout, but it won’t notice a foe coming from behind.

name: Watchog
description: When they see an enemy, their tails stand high, and they spit the seeds of berries stored in their cheek pouches.

name: Lillipup
description: This Pokémon is courageous but also cautious. It uses the soft fur covering its face to collect information about its surroundings.

name: Herdier
description: The black fur that covers this Pokémon’s body is dense and springy. Even sharp fangs bounce right off.

name: Stoutland
description: With this wise Pokémon, there could be no concern that it would ever attack people. Some parents even trust it to babysit.

name: Purrloin
description: Opponents that get drawn in by its adorable behavior come away with stinging scratches from its claws and stinging pride from its laughter.

name: Liepard
description: Don’t be fooled by its gorgeous fur and elegant figure. This is a moody and vicious Pokémon.

name: Pansage
description: It’s good at finding berries and gathers them from all over. It’s kind enough to share them with friends.

name: Simisage
description: Ill tempered, it fights by swinging its barbed tail around wildly. The leaf growing on its head is very bitter.

name: Pansear
description: This Pokémon lives in caves in volcanoes. The fire within the tuft on its head can reach 600 degrees Fahrenheit.

name: Simisear
description: When it gets excited, embers rise from its head and tail and it gets hot. For some reason, it loves sweets.

name: Panpour
description: The water stored inside the tuft on its head is full of nutrients. Plants that receive its water grow large.

name: Simipour
description: It prefers places with clean water. When its tuft runs low, it replenishes it by siphoning up water with its tail.

name: Munna
description: It eats dreams and releases mist. The mist is pink when it’s eating a good dream, and black when it’s eating a nightmare.

name: Musharna
description: It drowses and dreams all the time. It’s best to leave it be if it’s just woken up, as it’s a terrible grump when freshly roused from sleep.

name: Pidove
description: It’s forgetful and not very bright, but many Trainers love it anyway for its friendliness and sincerity.

name: Tranquill
description: These bright Pokémon have acute memories. Apparently delivery workers often choose them as their partners.

name: Unfezant
description: This Pokémon is intelligent and intensely proud. People will sit up and take notice if you become the Trainer of one.

name: Blitzle
description: Its mane shines when it discharges electricity. They use the frequency and rhythm of these flashes to communicate.

name: Zebstrika
description: When this ill-tempered Pokémon runs wild, it shoots lightning from its mane in all directions.

name: Roggenrola
description: When it detects a noise, it starts to move. The energy core inside it makes this Pokémon slightly warm to the touch.

name: Boldore
description: It relies on sound in order to monitor what’s in its vicinity. When angered, it will attack without ever changing the direction it’s facing.

name: Gigalith
description: Although its energy blasts can blow away a dump truck, they have a limitation— they can only be fired when the sun is out.

name: Woobat
description: It emits ultrasonic waves as it flutters about, searching for its prey—bug Pokémon.

name: Swoobat
description: Emitting powerful sound waves tires it out. Afterward, it won’t be able to fly for a little while.

name: Drilbur
description: It’s a digger, using its claws to burrow through the ground. It causes damage to vegetable crops, so many farmers have little love for it.

name: Excadrill
description: Known as the Drill King, this Pokémon can tunnel through the terrain at speeds of over 90 mph.

name: Audino
description: It touches others with the feelers on its ears, using the sound of their heartbeats to tell how they are feeling.

name: Timburr
description: It loves helping out with construction projects. It loves it so much that if rain causes work to halt, it swings its log around and throws a tantrum.

name: Gurdurr
description: This Pokémon is so muscular and strongly built that even a group of wrestlers could not make it budge an inch.

name: Conkeldurr
description: When going all out, this Pokémon throws aside its concrete pillars and leaps at opponents to pummel them with its fists.

name: Tympole
description: It uses sound waves to communicate with others of its kind. People and other Pokémon species can’t hear its cries of warning.

name: Palpitoad
description: It weakens its prey with sound waves intense enough to cause headaches, then entangles them with its sticky tongue.

name: Seismitoad
description: This Pokémon is popular among the elderly, who say the vibrations of its lumps are great for massages.

name: Throh
description: They train in groups of five. Any member that can’t keep up will discard its belt and leave the group.

name: Sawk
description: Tying their belts gets them pumped and makes their punches more destructive. Disturbing their training angers them.

name: Sewaddle
description: Since this Pokémon makes its own clothes out of leaves, it is a popular mascot for fashion designers.

name: Swadloon
description: It protects itself from the cold by wrapping up in leaves. It stays on the move, eating leaves in forests.

name: Leavanny
description: Upon finding a small Pokémon, it weaves clothing for it from leaves by using the sticky silk secreted from its mouth.

name: Venipede
description: Its fangs are highly venomous. If this Pokémon finds prey it thinks it can eat, it leaps for them without any thought of how things might turn out.

name: Whirlipede
description: This Pokémon spins itself rapidly and charges into its opponents. Its top speed is just over 60 mph.

name: Scolipede
description: With quick movements, it chases down its foes, attacking relentlessly with its horns until it prevails.

name: Cottonee
