description: It shoots cotton from its body to protect itself. If it gets caught up in hurricane-strength winds, it can get sent to the other side of the Earth.

name: Whimsicott
description: It scatters cotton all over the place as a prank. If it gets wet, it’ll become too heavy to move and have no choice but to answer for its mischief.

name: Petilil
description: The leaves on its head are highly valued for medicinal purposes. Dry the leaves in the sun, boil them, and then drink the bitter decoction for remarkably effective relief from fatigue.

name: Lilligant
description: I suspect that its well-developed legs are the result of a life spent on mountains covered in deep snow. The scent it exudes from its flower crown heartens those in proximity.

name: Basculin
description: Anglers love the fight this Pokémon puts up on the hook. And there are always more to catch— many people release them into lakes illicitly.

name: Sandile
description: The desert gets cold at night, so when the sun sets, this Pokémon burrows deep into the sand and sleeps until sunrise.

name: Krokorok
description: It buries some of its prey in the sand to use as emergency meals when its hunts are unsuccessful.

name: Krookodile
description: When it spots prey, even at a distance of over 30 miles, it swims through the desert as if it were water, then jumps out and chomps them.

name: Darumaka
description: This popular symbol of good fortune will never fall over in its sleep, no matter how it’s pushed or pulled.

name: Darmanitan
description: This Pokémon’s power level rises along with the temperature of its fire, which can reach 2,500 degrees Fahrenheit.

name: Maractus
description: Once each year, this Pokémon scatters its seeds. They’re jam-packed with nutrients, making them a precious food source out in the desert.

name: Dwebble
description: When it finds a stone of a suitable size, it secretes a liquid from its mouth to open up a hole to crawl into.

name: Crustle
description: This highly territorial Pokémon prefers dry climates. It won’t come out of its boulder on rainy days.

name: Scraggy
description: It protects itself with its durable skin. It’s thought that this Pokémon will evolve once its skin has completely stretched out.

name: Scrafty
description: While mostly known for having the temperament of an aggressive ruffian, this Pokémon takes very good care of its family, friends, and territory.

name: Sigilyph
description: Psychic power allows these Pokémon to fly. Some say they were the guardians of an ancient city. Others say they were the guardians’ emissaries.

name: Yamask
description: The spirit of a person from a bygone age became this Pokémon. It rambles through ruins, searching for someone who knows its face.

name: Cofagrigus
description: This Pokémon has a body of sparkling gold. People say it no longer remembers that it was once human.

name: Tirtouga
description: This Pokémon inhabited ancient seas. Although it can only crawl, it still comes up onto land in search of prey.

name: Carracosta
description: This Pokémon emerges from the water in search of prey despite the fact that it moves more slowly on land.

name: Archen
description: Restored from a fossil, this ancient bird Pokémon has wings but can’t yet fly.

name: Archeops
description: Said to be an ancestor of bird Pokémon, the muscles it uses to flap its wings are still weak, so it needs a long runway in order to take off.

name: Trubbish
description: Its favorite places are unsanitary ones. If you leave trash lying around, you could even find one of these Pokémon living in your room.

name: Garbodor
description: The toxic liquid it launches from its right arm is so virulent that it can kill a weakened creature instantly.

name: Zorua
description: This Pokémon has a cowardly disposition, so when it’s not around friends, it basically always stays transformed as something else.

name: Zoroark
description: This Pokémon cares deeply about others of its kind, and it will conjure terrifying illusions to keep its den and pack safe.

name: Minccino
description: They pet each other with their tails as a form of greeting. Of the two, the one whose tail is fluffier is a bit more boastful.

name: Cinccino
description: A special oil that seeps through their fur helps them avoid attacks. The oil fetches a high price at market.

name: Gothita
description: Though they’re still only babies, there’s psychic power stored in their ribbonlike feelers, and sometimes they use that power to fight.

name: Gothorita
description: It’s said that when stars shine in the night sky, this Pokémon will spirit away sleeping children. Some call it the Witch of Punishment.

name: Gothitelle
description: It has tremendous psychic power, but it dislikes conflict. It’s also able to predict the future based on the movement of the stars.

name: Solosis
description: Many say that the special liquid covering this Pokémon’s body would allow it to survive in the vacuum of space.

name: Duosion
description: Its brain has split into two, and the two halves rarely think alike. Its actions are utterly unpredictable.

name: Reuniclus
description: While it could use its psychic abilities in battle, this Pokémon prefers to swing its powerful arms around to beat opponents into submission.

name: Ducklett
description: They are better at swimming than flying, and they happily eat their favorite food, peat moss, as they dive underwater.

name: Swanna
description: Despite their elegant appearance, they can flap their wings strongly and fly for thousands of miles.

name: Vanillite
description: Supposedly, this Pokémon was born from an icicle. It spews out freezing air at −58 degrees Fahrenheit to make itself more comfortable.

name: Vanillish
description: It blasts enemies with cold air reaching −148 degrees Fahrenheit, freezing them solid. But it spares their lives afterward—it’s a kind Pokémon.

name: Vanilluxe
description: When its anger reaches a breaking point, this Pokémon unleashes a fierce blizzard that freezes every creature around it, be they friend or foe.

name: Deerling
description: The turning of the seasons changes the color and scent of this Pokémon’s fur. People use it to mark the seasons.

name: Sawsbuck
description: The plants growing on its horns change according to the season. The leaders of the herd possess magnificent horns.

name: Emolga
description: This Pokémon absolutely loves sweet berries. Sometimes it stuffs its cheeks full of so much food that it can’t fly properly.

name: Escavalier
description: They fly around at high speed, striking with their pointed spears. Even when in trouble, they face opponents bravely.

name: Foongus
description: The spores released from this Pokémon’s hands are highly poisonous, but when thoroughly dried, the spores can be used as stomach medicine.

name: Amoonguss
description: This Pokémon puffs poisonous spores at its foes. If the spores aren’t washed off quickly, they’ll grow into mushrooms wherever they land.

name: Frillish
description: Legend has it that the residents of a sunken ancient city changed into these Pokémon.

name: Jellicent
description: Most of this Pokémon’s body composition is identical to sea water. It makes sunken ships its lair.

name: Alomomola
description: It uses its special mucus to close the wounds of injured Pokémon. The reason for this behavior remains unknown.

name: Joltik
description: They attach themselves to large-bodied Pokémon and absorb static electricity, which they store in an electric pouch.

name: Galvantula
description: It lays traps of electrified threads near the nests of bird Pokémon, aiming to snare chicks that are not yet good at flying.

name: Ferroseed
description: It defends itself by launching spikes, but its aim isn’t very good at first. Only after a lot of practice will it improve.

name: Ferrothorn
description: Its spikes are harder than steel. This Pokémon crawls across rock walls by stabbing the spikes on its feelers into the stone.

name: Klink
description: The two minigears that compose this Pokémon are closer than twins. They mesh well only with each other.

name: Klang
description: A minigear and big gear comprise its body. If the minigear it launches at a foe doesn’t return, it will die.

name: Klinklang
description: The three gears that compose this Pokémon spin at high speed. Its new spiked gear isn’t a living creature.

name: Tynamo
description: One alone can emit only a trickle of electricity, so a group of them gathers to unleash a powerful electric shock.

name: Eelektrik
description: These Pokémon have a big appetite. When they spot their prey, they attack it and paralyze it with electricity.

name: Eelektross
description: They crawl out of the ocean using their arms. They will attack prey on shore and immediately drag it into the ocean.

name: Elgyem
description: This Pokémon was discovered about 50 years ago. Its highly developed brain enables it to exert its psychic powers.

name: Beheeyem
description: Sometimes found drifting above wheat fields, this Pokémon can control the memories of its opponents.

name: Litwick
description: The younger the life this Pokémon absorbs, the brighter and eerier the flame on its head burns.

name: Lampent
description: It lurks in cities, pretending to be a lamp. Once it finds someone whose death is near, it will trail quietly after them.

name: Chandelure
description: This Pokémon haunts dilapidated mansions. It sways its arms to hypnotize opponents with the ominous dancing of its flames.

name: Axew
description: They play with each other by knocking their large tusks together. Their tusks break sometimes, but they grow back so quickly that it isn’t a concern.

name: Fraxure
description: After battle, this Pokémon carefully sharpens its tusks on river rocks. It needs to take care of its tusks—if one breaks, it will never grow back.

name: Haxorus
description: Its resilient tusks are its pride and joy. It licks up dirt to take in the minerals it needs to keep its tusks in top condition.

name: Cubchoo
description: It sniffles before performing a move, using its frosty snot to provide an icy element to any move that needs it.

name: Beartic
description: It swims energetically through frigid seas. When it gets tired, it freezes the seawater with its breath so it can rest on the ice.

name: Cryogonal
description: They are composed of ice crystals. They capture prey with chains of ice, freezing the prey at -148 degrees Fahrenheit.

name: Shelmet
description: When attacked, it defends itself by closing the lid of its shell. It can spit a sticky, poisonous liquid.

name: Accelgor
description: Discarding its shell made it nimble. To keep itself from dehydrating, it wraps its body in bands of membrane.

name: Stunfisk
description: For some reason, this Pokémon smiles slightly when it emits a strong electric current from the yellow markings on its body.

name: Mienfoo
description: They seclude themselves in the mountains and devote themselves to training. The form of their kicks and chops differs from pack to pack.

name: Mienshao
description: Delivered at blinding speeds, kicks from this Pokémon can shatter massive boulders into tiny pieces.

name: Druddigon
description: The red skin on its face is harder than rock. In narrow caves, it squares off against its enemies and charges face-first right into them.

name: Golett
description: This Pokémon was created from clay. It received orders from its master many thousands of years ago, and it still follows those orders to this day.

name: Golurk
description: When the seal on its chest is removed, it rages indiscriminately, turning the whole town around it into a mountain of rubble.

name: Pawniard
description: It uses river stones to maintain the cutting edges of the blades covering its body. These sharpened blades allow it to bring down opponents.

name: Bouffalant
description: Their fluffy fur absorbs damage, even if they strike foes with a fierce headbutt.

name: Rufflet
description: Its chick-like looks belie its hotheadedness. It challenges its parents at every opportunity, desperate to prove its strength.

name: Braviary
description: Screaming a bloodcurdling battle cry, this huge and ferocious bird Pokémon goes out on the hunt. It blasts lakes with shock waves, then scoops up any prey that float to the water's surface.

name: Vullaby
description: It wears a bone to protect its rear. It often squabbles with others of its kind over particularly comfy bones.

name: Mandibuzz
description: They adorn themselves with bones. There seem to be fashion trends among them, as different bones come into and fall out of popularity.

name: Heatmor
description: There’s a hole in its tail that allows it to draw in the air it needs to keep its fire burning. If the hole gets blocked, this Pokémon will fall ill.

name: Deino
description: Because it can’t see, this Pokémon is constantly biting at everything it touches, trying to keep track of its surroundings.

name: Zweilous
description: After it has eaten up all the food in its territory, it moves to another area. Its two heads do not get along.

name: Hydreigon
description: The three heads take turns sinking their teeth into the opponent. Their attacks won’t slow until their target goes down.

name: Larvesta
description: When battling opponents, it sprays fire from its five horns. The max temperature of the flames can reach nearly 5,500 degrees Fahrenheit.

name: Volcarona
description: According to legends, it was hatched from a flaming cocoon to save people and Pokémon that were suffering from the cold.

name: Cobalion
description: From the moment it’s born, this Pokémon radiates the air of a leader. Its presence will calm even vicious foes.

name: Terrakion
description: It has phenomenal power. It will mercilessly crush anyone or anything that bullies small Pokémon.

name: Virizion
description: It darts around opponents with a flurry of quick movements, slicing them up with its horns.

name: Tornadus
description: This storm-stirring Pokémon is said to cause the seasons to turn by whipping up the air. I suspect its humanlike form to be a false one.

name: Thundurus
description: As it flies around, it shoots lightning all over the place and causes forest fires. It is therefore disliked.

name: Reshiram
description: Flames spew from its tail as it flies through the sky like a jet airplane. It’s said that this Pokémon will scorch the world.

name: Zekrom
description: Concealing itself in lightning clouds, it flies throughout the Unova region. It creates electricity in its tail.

name: Landorus
description: From the forces of lightning and wind, it creates energy to give nutrients to the soil and make the land abundant.

name: Kyurem
description: It appears that this Pokémon uses its powers over ice to freeze its own body in order to stabilize its cellular structure.

name: Keldeo
description: When it is resolute, its body fills with power and it becomes swifter. Its jumps are then too fast to follow.

name: Meloetta
description: Its melodies are sung with a special vocalization method that can control the feelings of those who hear it.

name: Genesect
description: This Pokémon existed 300 million years ago. Team Plasma altered it and attached a cannon to its back.

name: Chespin
description: Such a thick shell of wood covers its head and back that even a direct hit from a truck wouldn’t faze it.

name: Quilladin
description: They strengthen their lower bodies by running into one another. They are very kind and won’t start fights.

name: Chesnaught
description: When it takes a defensive posture with its fists guarding its face, it could withstand a bomb blast.

name: Fennekin
description: As it walks, it munches on a twig in place of a snack. It intimidates opponents by puffing hot air out of its ears.

name: Braixen
description: When the twig is plucked from its tail, friction sets the twig alight. The flame is used to send signals to its allies.

name: Delphox
description: Using psychic power, it generates a fiery vortex of 5,400 degrees Fahrenheit, incinerating foes swept into this whirl of flame.

name: Froakie
description: It protects its skin by covering its body in delicate bubbles. Beneath its happy-go-lucky air, it keeps a watchful eye on its surroundings.

name: Frogadier
description: Its swiftness is unparalleled. It can scale a tower of more than 2,000 feet in a minute’s time.

name: Greninja
description: It appears and vanishes with a ninja’s grace. It toys with its enemies using swift movements, while slicing them with throwing stars of sharpest water.

name: Bunnelby
description: It excels at digging holes. Using its ears, it can dig a nest 33 feet deep in one night.

name: Diggersby
description: The fur on its belly retains heat exceptionally well. People used to make heavy winter clothing from fur shed by this Pokémon.

name: Fletchling
description: Its body is always warm. Trainers who live in cold areas apparently sleep with it in their bed.

name: Fletchinder
description: Its speed right after takeoff already puts it in the top speed class of all bird Pokémon.

name: Talonflame
description: Bird Pokémon make up most of its diet. It approaches at high speeds and smacks them down to the ground with its powerful kick.

name: Scatterbug
description: The powder that covers its body regulates its temperature, so it can live in any region or climate.

name: Spewpa
description: The beaks of bird Pokémon can’t begin to scratch its stalwart body. To defend itself, it spews powder.

name: Vivillon
description: The patterns on this Pokémon’s wings depend on the climate and topography of its habitat. It scatters colorful scales.

name: Litleo
description: This hot-blooded Pokémon is filled with curiosity. When it gets angry or starts fighting, its short mane gets hot.

name: Pyroar
description: The males are usually lazy, but when attacked by a strong foe, a male will protect its friends with no regard for its own safety.

name: Flabébé
description: It’s not safe without the power of a flower, but it will keep traveling around until it finds one with the color and shape it wants.

name: Floette
description: It raises flowers and uses them as weapons. The more gorgeous the blossom, the more power it contains.

name: Florges
description: Its life can span several hundred years. It’s said to devote its entire life to protecting gardens.

name: Skiddo
description: If it has sunshine and water, it doesn’t need to eat, because it can generate energy from the leaves on its back.

name: Gogoat
description: They inhabit mountainous regions. The leader of the herd is decided by a battle of clashing horns.

name: Pancham
description: It’s desperate to intimidate its opponents. Be nice and pretend to be scared if you catch it glaring at you intensely.

name: Pangoro
description: This rowdy Pokémon boasts great physical strength. Many Trainers are also smitten by its lively character.

name: Furfrou
description: Left alone, its fur will grow longer and longer, but it will only allow someone it trusts to cut it.

name: Espurr
description: It has enough psychic energy to blast everything within 300 feet of itself, but it has no control over its power.

name: Meowstic
description: The defensive instinct of the males is strong. It’s when they’re protecting themselves or their partners that they unleash their full power.

name: Honedge
description: If anyone dares to grab its hilt, it wraps a blue cloth around that person’s arm and drains that person’s life energy completely.

name: Doublade
description: The two swords employ a strategy of rapidly alternating between offense and defense to bring down their prey.

name: Aegislash
description: Its potent spectral powers allow it to manipulate others. It once used its powers to force people and Pokémon to build a kingdom to its liking.

name: Spritzee
description: A scent pouch within this Pokémon’s body allows it to create various scents. A change in its diet will alter the fragrance it produces.

name: Aromatisse
description: The scent that constantly emits from its fur is so powerful that this Pokémon’s companions will eventually lose their sense of smell.

name: Swirlix
description: It eats its own weight in sugar every day. If it doesn’t get enough sugar, it becomes incredibly grumpy.

name: Slurpuff
description: By taking in a person’s scent, it can sniff out their mental and physical condition. It’s hoped that this skill will have many medical applications.

name: Inkay
description: It spins while making its luminescent spots flash. These spots allow it to communicate with others by using different patterns of light.

name: Malamar
description: It flashes the pattern on its torso to control its prey and draw them in. The edges of its fins are supremely sharp.

name: Binacle
description: If the two don’t work well together, both their offense and defense fall apart. Without good teamwork, they won’t survive.

name: Barbaracle
description: Having an eye on each palm allows it to keep watch in all directions. In a pinch, its limbs start to act on their own to ensure the enemy’s defeat.

name: Skrelp
description: It vanishes into seaweed and remains perfectly still to avoid attacks from large Pokémon. Rotten seaweed is its main food source.

name: Dragalge
description: It blends in with seaweed to ambush its prey and then takes them down with a poisonous liquid strong enough to melt metal.

name: Clauncher
description: It moves around by jetting water from its right pincer. It has a poor sense of balance, so it’s terrible at swimming straight.

name: Clawitzer
description: Its right arm is packed with meat. When its pincer falls off, it’s exported to be used as a cooking ingredient.

name: Helioptile
description: When spread, the frills on its head act like solar panels, generating the power behind this Pokémon’s electric moves.

name: Heliolisk
description: It stimulates its muscles with electricity, boosting the strength in its legs and enabling it to run 100 yards in five seconds.

name: Tyrunt
description: This Pokémon is selfish and likes to be pampered. It can also inflict grievous wounds on its Trainer just by playing around.

name: Tyrantrum
description: This Pokémon is from about 100,000,000 years ago. It has the presence of a king, vicious but magnificent.

name: Amaura
description: This Pokémon was successfully restored from a fossil. In the past, it lived with others of its kind in cold lands where there were fewer predators.

name: Aurorus
description: This usually quiet and kindly Pokémon has a surface temperature of around –240 degrees Fahrenheit.

name: Sylveon
description: It emits a soothing aura from its ribbon-shaped organs. It wraps these appendages around quarrelers to instantly restore calm to the situation.

name: Hawlucha
description: It always strikes a pose before going for its finishing move. Sometimes opponents take advantage of that time to counterattack.

name: Dedenne
description: Its upper whiskers are sensors that survey its surroundings. Its lower whiskers are organs that shoot electricity.

name: Carbink
description: Although this Pokémon is not especially rare, its glittering, jewel-draped body draws attention from people.

name: Goomy
description: Because most of its body is water, it will dry up if the weather becomes too arid. It’s considered the weakest dragon Pokémon.

name: Sliggoo
description: A creature given to melancholy. I suspect its metallic shell developed as a result of the mucus on its skin reacting with the iron in Hisui's water.

name: Goodra
description: Able to freely control the hardness of its metallic shell. It loathes solitude and is extremely clingy—it will fume and run riot if those dearest to it ever leave its side.

name: Klefki
description: It inserts its horn into chinks in metal, absorbing metal ions. For some reason, it collects keys.

name: Phantump
description: With a voice like a human child’s, it cries out to lure adults deep into the forest, getting them lost among the trees.

name: Trevenant
description: People fear it due to a belief that it devours any who try to cut down trees in its forest, but to the Pokémon it shares its woods with, it’s kind.

name: Pumpkaboo
description: The light that streams out from the holes in the pumpkin can hypnotize and control the people and Pokémon that see it.

name: Gourgeist
description: Eerie cries emanate from its body in the dead of night. The sounds are said to be the wails of spirits who are suffering in the afterlife.

name: Bergmite
description: Lives on mountains blanketed in perennial snow. It freezes water vapor in the air to make the ice helmet that it dons for defense.

name: Avalugg
description: The armor of ice covering its lower jaw puts steel to shame and can shatter rocks with ease. This Pokémon barrels along steep mountain paths, cleaving through the deep snow.

name: Noibat
description: After nightfall, they emerge from the caves they nest in during the day. Using their ultrasonic waves, they go on the hunt for ripened fruit.

name: Noivern
description: Flying through the darkness, it weakens enemies with ultrasonic waves that could crush stone. Its fangs finish the fight.

name: Xerneas
description: When the horns on its head shine in seven colors, it is said to be sharing everlasting life.

name: Yveltal
description: When its life comes to an end, it absorbs the life energy of every living thing and turns into a cocoon once more.

name: Zygarde
description: Some say it can change to an even more powerful form when battling those who threaten the ecosystem.

name: Diancie
description: It can instantly create many diamonds by compressing the carbon in the air between its hands.

name: Hoopa
description: It is said to be able to seize anything it desires with its six rings and six huge arms. With its power sealed, it is transformed into a much smaller form.

name: Volcanion
description: It expels its internal steam from the arms on its back. It has enough power to blow away a mountain.

name: Rowlet
description: Flies noiselessly on delicate wings. It has mastered the art of deftly launching dagger-sharp feathers from those same wings.

name: Dartrix
description: Regularly basks in sunlight to gather power—presumably due to the frigid climate. Nonetheless, the edges of the blade quills set into its wings are keen as ever.

name: Decidueye
description: In a tenth of a second, it can nock and fire an arrow quill, piercing an opponent’s weak point before they notice what’s happening.

name: Litten
description: It spends even the smallest amount of downtime grooming its fur with its tongue. Loose fur gathers in its stomach and serves as fuel for fiery moves.

name: Torracat
description: When its mane is standing on end, you can tell it’s feeling good. When it isn’t feeling well, its fur will lie down flat.

name: Incineroar
description: It excels at violent, no-holds-barred battles. The temperature of the flames that issue from its navel exceeds 3,600 degrees Fahrenheit.

name: Popplio
description: It creates special bouncy balloons to send at its opponents. When the balloons pop, the sheer force of their bursting is what deals damage.

name: Brionne
description: As if dancing, it artfully dodges the attacks of its enemies. All the while, it’s busy forming a bunch of balloons to overwhelm its foes.

name: Primarina
description: With its mouth, it makes sonic waves that sound like beautiful singing. It uses the sonic waves to control its water balloons.

name: Pikipek
description: It may look spindly, but its neck muscles are heavy-duty. It can peck at a tree 16 times per second!

name: Trumbeak
description: From its mouth, it fires the seeds of berries it has eaten. The scattered seeds give rise to new plants.

name: Toucannon
description: Known for forming harmonious couples, this Pokémon is brought to wedding ceremonies as a good luck charm.

name: Yungoos
description: Although it will eat anything, it prefers fresh living things, so it marches down streets in search of prey.

name: Gumshoos
description: When it finds a trace of its prey, it patiently stakes out the location...but it’s always snoozing by nightfall.

name: Grubbin
description: It uses its big jaws to dig nests into the forest floor, and it loves to feed on sweet tree sap.

name: Charjabug
description: Its digestive processes convert the leaves it eats into electricity. An electric sac in its belly stores the electricity for later use.

name: Vikavolt
description: It builds up electricity in its abdomen, focuses it through its jaws, and then fires the electricity off in concentrated beams.

name: Crabrawler
description: It punches so much, its pincers often come off from overuse, but they grow back quickly. What little meat they contain is rich and delicious.

name: Crabominable
description: Before it stops to think, it just starts pummeling. There are records of its turning back avalanches with a flurry of punches.

name: Oricorio
description: It wins the hearts of its enemies with its passionate dancing and then uses the opening it creates to burn them up with blazing flames.

name: Cutiefly
description: It feeds on the nectar and pollen of flowers. Because it’s able to sense auras, it can identify which flowers are about to bloom.

name: Ribombee
description: It makes pollen puffs from pollen and nectar. The puffs’ effects depend on the type of ingredients and how much of each one is used.

name: Rockruff
description: When it rubs the rocks on its neck against you, that’s proof of its love for you. However, the rocks are sharp, so the gesture is quite painful!

name: Lycanroc
description: The rocks in its mane are sharper than a knife. Fragments that break off are treasured as good luck charms.

name: Wishiwashi
description: Individually, they’re incredibly weak. It’s by gathering up into schools that they’re able to confront opponents.

name: Mareanie
description: The first symptom of its sting is numbness. The next is an itching sensation so intense that it’s impossible to resist the urge to claw at your skin.

name: Toxapex
description: To survive in the cold waters of Galar, this Pokémon forms a dome with its legs, enclosing its body so it can capture its own body heat.

name: Mudbray
description: It eats dirt to create mud and smears this mud all over its feet, giving them the grip needed to walk on rough terrain without slipping.

name: Mudsdale
description: It can trudge mountain roads without rest for three days and three nights, all the while dragging a 10-ton load.

name: Dewpider
description: It can only breathe oxygen that has dissolved in water, so it wears a water bubble on its head when it walks around on land.

name: Araquanid
description: It launches water bubbles with its legs, drowning prey within the bubbles. This Pokémon can then take its time to savor its meal.

name: Fomantis
description: When bathed in sunlight, this Pokémon emits a pleasantly sweet scent, which causes bug Pokémon to gather around it.

name: Lurantis
description: As it slashes into its enemies, it looks like it’s dancing. Its elegant appearance has led some to call it the most glamorous Grass Pokémon.

name: Morelull
description: It likes damp dark places. When night falls, the spores filling the caps of its mushrooms glow.

name: Shiinotic
description: Its flickering spores lure in prey and put them to sleep. Once this Pokémon has its prey snoozing, it drains their vitality with its fingertips.

name: Salandit
description: The males will do whatever the females tell them. They give the females most of their food. Due to malnutrition, the males can’t evolve.

name: Salazzle
description: Filled with pheromones, its poisonous gas can be diluted to use in the production of luscious perfumes.

name: Stufful
description: The way it protects itself by flailing its arms may be an adorable sight, but stay well away. This is flailing that can snap thick tree trunks.

name: Bewear
description: The moves it uses to take down its prey would make a martial artist jealous. It tucks subdued prey under its arms to carry them to its nest.

name: Bounsweet
description: When under attack, it secretes a sweet and delicious sweat. The scent only calls more enemies to it.

name: Steenee
description: As it twirls like a dancer, a sweet smell spreads out around it. Anyone who inhales the scent will feel a surge of happiness.

name: Tsareena
description: A kick from the hardened tips of this Pokémon’s legs leaves a wound in the opponent’s body and soul that will never heal.

name: Comfey
description: It picks flowers and sticks them to its body with fluids it produces. The aroma that wafts from its petals has a healing effect.

name: Oranguru
description: It normally spends its time meditating in the treetops. It throws Poké Balls and gives other Pokémon orders as it pleases.

name: Passimian
description: Displaying amazing teamwork, they follow the orders of their boss as they all help out in the search for their favorite berries.

name: Wimpod
description: It’s nature’s cleaner—it eats anything and everything, including garbage and rotten things. The ground near its nest is always clean.

name: Golisopod
description: It will do anything to win, taking advantage of every opening and finishing opponents off with the small claws on its front legs.

name: Sandygast
description: It takes control of anyone who puts a hand in its mouth. And so it adds to the accumulation of its sand-mound body.

name: Palossand
description: Once it has whipped up a sandstorm to halt its opponents in their tracks, this terrifying Pokémon snatches away their vitality.

name: Pyukumuku
description: It’s covered in a slime that keeps its skin moist, allowing it to stay on land for days without drying up.

name: Type: Null
description: It was modeled after a mighty Pokémon of myth. The mask placed upon it limits its power in order to keep it under control.

name: Silvally
description: The final factor needed to release this Pokémon’s true power was a strong bond with a Trainer it trusts.

name: Minior
description: Although its outer shell is uncommonly durable, the shock of falling to the ground smashes the shell to smithereens.

name: Komala
description: It remains asleep from birth to death as a result of the sedative properties of the leaves that form its diet.

name: Turtonator
description: Eating sulfur in its volcanic habitat is what causes explosive compounds to develop in its shell. Its droppings are also dangerously explosive.

name: Togedemaru
description: When it’s in trouble, it curls up into a ball, makes its fur spikes stand on end, and then discharges electricity indiscriminately.

name: Mimikyu
description: A gust of wind revealed what hides under this Pokémon’s rag to a passing Trainer, who went home and died painfully that very night.

name: Bruxish
description: It burrows beneath the sand, radiating psychic power from the protuberance on its head. It waits for prey as it surveys the area.

name: Drampa
description: The mountains it calls home are nearly two miles in height. On rare occasions, it descends to play with the children living in the towns below.

name: Dhelmise
description: After a piece of seaweed merged with debris from a sunken ship, it was reborn as this ghost Pokémon.

name: Jangmo-o
description: They learn to fight by smashing their head scales together. The dueling strengthens both their skills and their spirits.

name: Hakamo-o
description: Before attacking its enemies, it clashes its scales together and roars. Its sharp claws shred the opposition.

name: Kommo-o
description: It clatters its tail scales to unnerve opponents. This Pokémon will battle only those who stand steadfast in the face of this display.

name: Tapu Koko
description: Although it’s called a guardian deity, if a person or Pokémon puts it in a bad mood, it will become a malevolent deity and attack.

name: Tapu Lele
description: It heals the wounds of people and Pokémon by sprinkling them with its sparkling scales. This guardian deity is worshiped on Akala.

name: Tapu Bulu
description: It makes ringing sounds with its tail to let others know where it is, avoiding unneeded conflicts. This guardian deity of Ula’ula controls plants.

name: Tapu Fini
description: This guardian deity of Poni Island manipulates water. Because it lives deep within a thick fog, it came to be both feared and revered.

name: Cosmog
description: This Pokémon came from another universe. Its gaseous body is so light that even a gentle breeze can blow it away.

name: Cosmoem
description: It sucks in dust from the air at an astounding rate, frantically building up energy within its core as preparation for evolution.

name: Solgaleo
description: When light radiates from its body, this Pokémon could almost appear to be the sun. It will dispel any darkness and light up the world.

name: Lunala
description: It steals the light from its surroundings and then becomes the full moon, showering its own light across the night sky.

name: Nihilego
description: A life-form from another world, it was dubbed a UB and is thought to produce a strong neurotoxin.

name: Buzzwole
description: Although it’s alien to this world and a danger here, it’s apparently a common organism in the world where it normally lives.

name: Pheromosa
description: Although it’s alien to this world and a danger here, it’s apparently a common organism in the world where it normally lives.

name: Xurkitree
description: They’ve been dubbed Ultra Beasts. Some of them stand unmoving, like trees, with their arms and legs stuck into the ground.

name: Celesteela
description: Although it’s alien to this world and a danger here, it’s apparently a common organism in the world where it normally lives.

name: Kartana
description: Although it’s alien to this world and a danger here, it’s apparently a common organism in the world where it normally lives.

name: Guzzlord
description: An unknown life-form called a UB. It may be constantly hungry—it is certainly always devouring something.

name: Necrozma
description: It needs light to survive, and it goes on a rampage seeking it out. Its laser beams will cut anything to pieces.

name: Magearna
description: Built roughly 500 years ago by a scientist, the part called the Soul-Heart is the actual life-form.

name: Marshadow
description: This Pokémon can conceal itself in any shadow, so it went undiscovered for a long time.

name: Poipole
description: An Ultra Beast that lives in a different world, it cackles wildly as it sprays its opponents with poison from the needles on its head.

name: Naganadel
description: One kind of Ultra Beast, it fires a glowing, venomous liquid from its needles. This liquid is also immensely adhesive.

name: Stakataka
description: When stone walls started moving and attacking, the brute’s true identity was this mysterious life-form, which brings to mind an Ultra Beast.

name: Blacephalon
description: A UB that appeared from an Ultra Wormhole, it causes explosions, then takes advantage of opponents’ surprise to rob them of their vitality.

name: Zeraora
description: It runs as fast as lightning strikes, shredding its opponents with its high-voltage claws.

name: Meltan
description: It dissolves and eats metal. Circulating liquid metal within its body is how it generates energy.

name: Melmetal
description: Revered long ago for its capacity to create iron from nothing, for some reason it has come back to life after 3,000 years.

name: Grookey
description: It attacks with rapid beats of its stick. As it strikes with amazing speed, it gets more and more pumped.

name: Thwackey
description: When it’s drumming out rapid beats in battle, it gets so caught up in the rhythm that it won’t even notice that it’s already knocked out its opponent.

name: Rillaboom
description: The one with the best drumming techniques becomes the boss of the troop. It has a gentle disposition and values harmony among its group.

name: Scorbunny
description: It has special pads on the backs of its feet, and one on its nose. Once it’s raring to fight, these pads radiate tremendous heat.

name: Raboot
description: It kicks berries right off the branches of trees and then juggles them with its feet, practicing its footwork.

name: Cinderace
description: It’s skilled at both offense and defense, and it gets pumped up when cheered on. But if it starts showboating, it could put itself in a tough spot.

name: Sobble
description: When it gets wet, its skin changes color, and this Pokémon becomes invisible as if it were camouflaged.

name: Drizzile
description: Highly intelligent but also very lazy, it keeps enemies out of its territory by laying traps everywhere.

name: Inteleon
description: Its nictitating membranes let it pick out foes’ weak points so it can precisely blast them with water that shoots from its fingertips at Mach 3.

name: Skwovet
description: It eats berries nonstop—a habit that has made it more resilient than it looks. It’ll show up on farms, searching for yet more berries.

name: Greedent
description: Common throughout the Galar region, this Pokémon has strong teeth and can chew through the toughest of berry shells.

name: Rookidee
description: Jumping nimbly about, this small-bodied Pokémon takes advantage of even the slightest opportunity to disorient larger opponents.

name: Corvisquire
description: The lessons of many harsh battles have taught it how to accurately judge an opponent’s strength.

name: Corviknight
description: With their great intellect and flying skills, these Pokémon very successfully act as the Galar region’s airborne taxi service.

name: Blipbug
description: Often found in gardens, this Pokémon has hairs on its body that it uses to assess its surroundings.

name: Dottler
description: As it grows inside its shell, it uses its psychic abilities to monitor the outside world and prepare for evolution.

name: Orbeetle
description: It emits psychic energy to observe and study what’s around it—and what’s around it can include things over six miles away.

name: Nickit
description: Cunning and cautious, this Pokémon survives by stealing food from others. It erases its tracks with swipes of its tail as it makes off with its plunder.

name: Thievul
description: It secretly marks potential targets with a scent. By following the scent, it stalks its targets and steals from them when they least expect it.

name: Gossifleur
description: It whirls around in the wind while singing a joyous song. This delightful display has charmed many into raising this Pokémon.

name: Eldegoss
description: The cotton on the head of this Pokémon can be spun into a glossy, gorgeous yarn—a Galar regional specialty.

name: Wooloo
description: Its curly fleece is such an effective cushion that this Pokémon could fall off a cliff and stand right back up at the bottom, unharmed.

name: Dubwool
description: Its majestic horns are meant only to impress the opposite gender. They never see use in battle.

name: Chewtle
description: It starts off battles by attacking with its rock-hard horn, but as soon as the opponent flinches, this Pokémon bites down and never lets go.

name: Drednaw
description: This Pokémon rapidly extends its retractable neck to sink its sharp fangs into distant enemies and take them down.

name: Yamper
description: This gluttonous Pokémon only assists people with their work because it wants treats. As it runs, it crackles with electricity.

name: Boltund
description: It sends electricity through its legs to boost their strength. Running at top speed, it easily breaks 50 mph.

name: Rolycoly
description: It can race around like a unicycle, even on rough, rocky terrain. Burning coal sustains it.

name: Carkol
description: By rapidly rolling its legs, it can travel at over 18 mph. The temperature of the flames it breathes exceeds 1,800 degrees Fahrenheit.

name: Coalossal
description: While it’s engaged in battle, its mountain of coal will burn bright red, sending off sparks that scorch the surrounding area.

name: Applin
description: As soon as it’s born, it burrows into an apple. Not only does the apple serve as its food source, but the flavor of the fruit determines its evolution.

name: Flapple
description: It flies on wings of apple skin and spits a powerful acid. It can also change its shape into that of an apple.

name: Appletun
description: Its body is covered in sweet nectar, and the skin on its back is especially yummy. Children used to have it as a snack.

name: Silicobra
description: It spews sand from its nostrils. While the enemy is blinded, it burrows into the ground to hide.

name: Sandaconda
description: Its unique style of coiling allows it to blast sand out of its sand sac more efficiently.

name: Cramorant
description: It’s so strong that it can knock out some opponents in a single hit, but it also may forget what it’s battling midfight.

name: Arrokuda
description: If it sees any movement around it, this Pokémon charges for it straightaway, leading with its sharply pointed jaw. It’s very proud of that jaw.

name: Barraskewda
description: It spins its tail fins to propel itself, surging forward at speeds of over 100 knots before ramming prey and spearing into them.

name: Toxel
description: It manipulates the chemical makeup of its poison to produce electricity. The voltage is weak, but it can cause a tingling paralysis.

name: Toxtricity
description: This short-tempered and aggressive Pokémon chugs stagnant water to absorb any toxins it might contain.

name: Sizzlipede
description: It wraps prey up with its heated body, cooking them in its coils. Once they’re well-done, it will voraciously nibble them down to the last morsel.

name: Centiskorch
description: While its burning body is already dangerous on its own, this excessively hostile Pokémon also has large and very sharp fangs.

name: Clobbopus
description: Its tentacles tear off easily, but it isn’t alarmed when that happens—it knows they’ll grow back. It’s about as smart as a three-year-old.

name: Grapploct
description: Searching for an opponent to test its skills against, it emerges onto land. Once the battle is over, it returns to the sea.

name: Sinistea
description: The teacup in which this Pokémon makes its home is a famous piece of antique tableware. Many forgeries are in circulation.

name: Polteageist
description: This species lives in antique teapots. Most pots are forgeries, but on rare occasions, an authentic work is found.

name: Hatenna
description: If this Pokémon senses a strong emotion, it will run away as fast as it can. It prefers areas without people.

name: Hattrem
description: Using the braids on its head, it pummels foes to get them to quiet down. One blow from those braids would knock out a professional boxer.

name: Hatterene
description: If you’re too loud around it, you risk being torn apart by the claws on its tentacle. This Pokémon is also known as the Forest Witch.

name: Impidimp
description: It sneaks into people’s homes, stealing things and feasting on the negative energy of the frustrated occupants.

name: Morgrem
description: With sly cunning, it tries to lure people into the woods. Some believe it to have the power to make crops grow.

name: Grimmsnarl
description: Its hairs work like muscle fibers. When its hairs unfurl, they latch on to opponents, ensnaring them as tentacles would.

name: Obstagoon
description: It evolved after experiencing numerous fights. While crossing its arms, it lets out a shout that would make any opponent flinch.

name: Perrserker
description: After many battles, it evolved dangerous claws that come together to form daggers when extended.

name: Cursola
description: Be cautious of the ectoplasmic body surrounding its soul. You’ll become stiff as stone if you touch it.

name: Sirfetch’d
description: After deflecting attacks with its hard leaf shield, it strikes back with its sharp leek stalk. The leek stalk is both weapon and food.

name: Mr. Rime
description: Its amusing movements make it very popular. It releases its psychic power from the pattern on its belly.

name: Runerigus
description: Never touch its shadowlike body, or you’ll be shown the horrific memories behind the picture carved into it.

name: Milcery
description: This Pokémon was born from sweet-smelling particles in the air. Its body is made of cream.

name: Alcremie
description: When it trusts a Trainer, it will treat them to berries it’s decorated with cream.

name: Falinks
description: The six of them work together as one Pokémon. Teamwork is also their battle strategy, and they constantly change their formation as they fight.

name: Pincurchin
description: It stores electricity in each spine. Even if one gets broken off, it still continues to emit electricity for at least three hours.

name: Snom
description: It eats snow that piles up on the ground. The more snow it eats, the bigger and more impressive the spikes on its back grow.

name: Frosmoth
description: It shows no mercy to any who desecrate fields and mountains. It will fly around on its icy wings, causing a blizzard to chase offenders away.

name: Stonjourner
description: Once a year, on a specific date and at a specific time, they gather out of nowhere and form up in a circle.

name: Eiscue
description: This Pokémon keeps its heat-sensitive head cool with ice. It fishes for its food, dangling its single hair into the sea to lure in prey.

name: Indeedee
description: Through its horns, it can pick up on the emotions of creatures around it. Positive emotions are the source of its strength.

name: Morpeko
description: It carries electrically roasted seeds with it as if they’re precious treasures. No matter how much it eats, it always gets hungry again in short order.

name: Cufant
description: If a job requires serious strength, this Pokémon will excel at it. Its copper body tarnishes in the rain, turning a vibrant green color.

name: Copperajah
description: These Pokémon live in herds. Their trunks have incredible grip strength, strong enough to crush giant rocks into powder.

name: Dracozolt
description: The powerful muscles in its tail generate its electricity. Compared to its lower body, its upper half is entirely too small.

name: Arctozolt
description: This Pokémon lived on prehistoric seashores and was able to preserve food with the ice on its body. It went extinct because it moved so slowly.

name: Dracovish
description: Its mighty legs are capable of running at speeds exceeding 40 mph, but this Pokémon can’t breathe unless it’s underwater.

name: Arctovish
description: The skin on its face is impervious to attack, but breathing difficulties made this Pokémon go extinct anyway.

name: Duraludon
description: The special metal that composes its body is very light, so this Pokémon has considerable agility. It lives in caves because it dislikes the rain.

name: Zacian
description: Known as a legendary hero, this Pokémon absorbs metal particles, transforming them into a weapon it uses to battle.

name: Zamazenta
description: This Pokémon slept for aeons while in the form of a statue. It was asleep for so long, people forgot that it ever existed.

name: Eternatus
description: It was inside a meteorite that fell 20,000 years ago. There seems to be a connection between this Pokémon and the Dynamax phenomenon.

name: Urshifu
description: Inhabiting the mountains of a distant region, this Pokémon races across sheer cliffs, training its legs and refining its moves.

name: Zarude
description: Within dense forests, this Pokémon lives in a pack with others of its kind. It’s incredibly aggressive, and the other Pokémon of the forest fear it.

name: Wyrdeer
description: The black orbs shine with an uncanny light when the Pokémon is erecting invisible barriers. The fur shed from its beard retains heat well and is a highly useful material for winter clothing.

name: Kleavor
description: A violent creature that fells towering trees with its crude axes and shields itself with hard stone. If one should chance upon this Pokémon in the wilds, one's only recourse is to flee.

name: Overqwil
description: Its lancelike spikes and savage temperament have earned it the nickname ”sea fiend.” It slurps up poison to nourish itself.

name: Enamorus
description: When it flies to this land from across the sea, the bitter winter comes to an end. According to legend, this Pokémon's love gives rise to the budding of fresh life across Hisui.

name: Sprigatito
description: The sweet scent its body gives off mesmerizes those around it. The scent grows stronger when this Pokémon is in the sun.

name: Meowscarada
description: This Pokémon uses the reflective fur lining its cape to camouflage the stem of its flower, creating the illusion that the flower is floating.

name: Fuecoco
description: It lies on warm rocks and uses the heat absorbed by its square-shaped scales to create fire energy.

name: Quaxly
description: Its strong legs let it easily swim around in even fast-flowing rivers. It likes to keep things tidy and is prone to overthinking things.

name: Quaxwell
description: These Pokémon constantly run through shallow waters to train their legs, then compete with each other to see which of them kicks most gracefully.

name: Quaquaval
description: Dancing in ways that evoke far-away places, this Pokémon mesmerizes all that see it. Flourishes of its decorative water feathers slice into its foes.

name: Lechonk
description: This Pokémon spurns all but the finest of foods. Its body gives off an herblike scent that bug Pokémon detest.

name: Oinkologne
description: It entrances female Pokémon with the sweet, alluring scent that wafts from all over its body.

name: Tarountula
description: The thread it secretes from its rear is as strong as wire. The secret behind the thread’s strength is the topic of ongoing research.

name: Spidops
description: It clings to branches and ceilings using its threads and moves without a sound. It takes out its prey before the prey even notices it.

name: Nymble
description: It’s highly skilled at a fighting style in which it uses its jumping capabilities to dodge incoming attacks while also dealing damage to opponents.

name: Lokix
description: It uses its normally folded third set of legs when in Showdown Mode. This places a huge burden on its body, so it can’t stay in this mode for long.

name: Pawmot
description: This Pokémon normally is slow to react, but once it enters battle, it will strike down its enemies with lightning-fast movements.

name: Tandemaus
description: The pair sticks together no matter what. They split any food they find exactly in half and then eat it together.

name: Maushold
description: The larger pair protects the little ones during battles. When facing strong opponents, the whole group will join the fight.

name: Dachsbun
description: The surface of this Pokémon’s skin hardens when exposed to intense heat, and its body has an appetizing aroma.

name: Smoliv
description: This Pokémon converts nutrients into oil, which it stores in the fruit on its head. It can easily go a whole week without eating or drinking.

name: Arboliva
description: This Pokémon drives back enemies by launching its rich, aromatic oil at them with enough force to smash a boulder.

name: Squawkabilly
description: Green-feathered flocks hold the most sway. When they’re out searching for food in the mornings and evenings, it gets very noisy.

name: Nacli
description: It was born in a layer of rock salt deep under the earth. This species was particularly treasured in the old days, as they would share precious salt.

name: Naclstack
description: It compresses rock salt inside its body and shoots out hardened salt pellets with enough force to perforate an iron sheet.

name: Charcadet
description: Its firepower increases when it fights, reaching over 1,800 degrees Fahrenheit. It likes berries that are rich in fat.

name: Armarouge
description: This Pokémon clads itself in armor that has been fortified by psychic and fire energy, and it shoots blazing fireballs.

name: Ceruledge
description: The fiery blades on its arms burn fiercely with the lingering resentment of a sword wielder who fell before accomplishing their goal.

name: Bellibolt
description: When this Pokémon expands and contracts its wobbly body, the belly-button dynamo in its stomach produces a huge amount of electricity.

name: Wattrel
description: These Pokémon make their nests on coastal cliffs. The nests have a strange, crackling texture, and they’re a popular delicacy.

name: Kilowattrel
description: It uses its throat sac to store electricity generated by its wings. There’s hardly any oil in its feathers, so it is a poor swimmer.

name: Maschiff
description: Its well-developed jaw and fangs are strong enough to crunch through boulders, and its thick fat makes for an excellent defense.

name: Shroodle
description: To keep enemies away from its territory, it paints markings around its nest using a poisonous liquid that has an acrid odor.

name: Bramblin
description: A soul unable to move on to the afterlife was blown around by the wind until it got tangled up with dried grass and became a Pokémon.

name: Brambleghast
description: It will open the branches of its head to envelop its prey. Once it absorbs all the life energy it needs, it expels the prey and discards it.

name: Toedscruel
description: It coils its 10 tentacles around prey and sucks out their nutrients, causing the prey pain. The folds along the rim of its head are a popular delicacy.

name: Klawf
description: This Pokémon lives on sheer cliffs. It sidesteps opponents’ attacks, then lunges for their weak spots with its claws.

name: Capsakid
description: The more sunlight this Pokémon bathes in, the more spicy chemicals are produced by its body, and thus the spicier its moves become.

name: Scovillain
description: The green head has turned vicious due to the spicy chemicals stimulating its brain. Once it goes on a rampage, there is no stopping it.

name: Rellor
description: It rolls its mud ball around while the energy it needs for evolution matures. Eventually the time comes for it to evolve.

name: Rabsca
description: The body that supports the ball barely moves. Therefore, it is thought that the true body of this Pokémon is actually inside the ball.

name: Flittle
description: It spends its time running around wastelands. If anyone steals its beloved berries, it will chase them down and exact its revenge.

name: Espathra
description: It emits psychic power from the gaps between its multicolored frills and sprints at speeds greater than 120 mph.

name: Tinkatink
description: This Pokémon pounds iron scraps together to make a hammer. It will remake the hammer again and again until it’s satisfied with the result.

name: Tinkatuff
description: These Pokémon make their homes in piles of scrap metal. They test the strength of each other’s hammers by smashing them together.

name: Wugtrio
description: It has a vicious temperament, contrary to what its appearance may suggest. It wraps its long bodies around prey, then drags the prey into its den.

name: Bombirdier
description: It gathers things up in an apron made from shed feathers added to the Pokémon’s chest feathers, then drops those things from high places for fun.

name: Finizen
description: It likes playing with others of its kind using the water ring on its tail. It uses ultrasonic waves to sense the emotions of other living creatures.

name: Varoom
description: It is said that this Pokémon was born when an unknown poison Pokémon entered and inspirited an engine left at a scrap-processing factory.

name: Revavroom
description: It creates a gas out of poison and minerals from rocks. It then detonates the gas in its cylinders—now numbering eight—to generate energy.

name: Orthworm
description: This Pokémon lives in arid deserts. It maintains its metal body by consuming iron from the soil.

name: Glimmet
description: It absorbs nutrients from cave walls. The petals it wears are made of crystallized poison.

name: Glimmora
description: When this Pokémon detects danger, it will open up its crystalline petals and fire beams from its conical body.

name: Greavard
description: This friendly Pokémon doesn’t like being alone. Pay it even the slightest bit of attention, and it will follow you forever.

name: Flamigo
description: Thanks to a behavior of theirs known as “synchronizing,” an entire flock of these Pokémon can attack simultaneously in perfect harmony.

name: Cetoddle
description: It lives in frigid regions in pods of five or so individuals. It loves the minerals found in snow and ice.

name: Cetitan
description: Ice energy builds up in the horn on its upper jaw, causing the horn to reach cryogenic temperatures that freeze its surroundings.

name: Annihilape
description: It imbues its fists with the power of the rage that it kept hidden in its heart. Opponents struck by these imbued fists will be shattered to their core.

name: Clodsire
description: When attacked, this Pokémon will retaliate by sticking thick spines out from its body. It’s a risky move that puts everything on the line.

name: Dudunsparce
description: It drives enemies out of its nest by sucking in enough air to fill its long, narrow lungs, then releasing the air in an intense blast.

name: Kingambit
description: Though it commands a massive army in battle, it’s not skilled at devising complex strategies. It just uses brute strength to keep pushing.

name: Great Tusk
description: This creature resembles a mysterious Pokémon that, according to a paranormal magazine, has lived since ancient times.

name: Scream Tail
description: There has been only one reported sighting of this Pokémon. It resembles a mysterious creature depicted in an old expedition journal.

name: Brute Bonnet
description: It bears a slight resemblance to a Pokémon described in a dubious magazine as a cross between a dinosaur and a mushroom.

name: Flutter Mane
description: It has similar features to a ghostly pterosaur that was covered in a paranormal magazine, but the two have little else in common.

name: Sandy Shocks
description: No records exist of this Pokémon being caught. Data is lacking, but the Pokémon’s traits match up with a creature shown in an expedition journal.

name: Iron Treads
description: Sightings of this Pokémon have occurred in recent years. It resembles a mysterious object described in an old expedition journal.

name: Iron Bundle
description: It resembles a mysterious object mentioned in an old book. There are only two reported sightings of this Pokémon.

name: Iron Hands
description: It is very similar to a cyborg covered exclusively by a paranormal magazine. The cyborg was said to be the modified form of a certain athlete.

name: Iron Moth
description: No records exist of this species being caught. Data is lacking, but the Pokémon’s traits match up with an object described in an old book.

name: Frigibax
description: This Pokémon lives in forests and craggy areas. Using the power of its dorsal fin, it cools the inside of its nest like a refrigerator.

name: Baxcalibur
description: It launches itself into battle by flipping upside down and spewing frigid air from its mouth. It finishes opponents off with its dorsal blade.

name: Gimmighoul
description: It lives inside an old treasure chest. Sometimes it gets left in shop corners since no one realizes it’s actually a Pokémon.

name: Gholdengo
description: Its body seems to be made up of 1,000 coins. This Pokémon gets along well with others and is quick to make friends with anybody.

name: Wo-Chien
description: It drains the life-force from vegetation, causing nearby forests to instantly wither and fields to turn barren.

name: Chien-Pao
description: The hatred of those who perished by the sword long ago has clad itself in snow and become a Pokémon.

name: Ting-Lu
description: It slowly brings its exceedingly heavy head down upon the ground, splitting the earth open with huge fissures that run over 160 feet deep.

name: Chi-Yu
description: The envy accumulated within curved beads that sparked multiple conflicts has clad itself in fire and become a Pokémon.

name: Roaring Moon
description: According to an article in a dubious magazine, this Pokémon has some connection to a phenomenon that occurs in a certain region.

name: Iron Valiant
description: It has some similarities to a mad scientist’s invention covered in a paranormal magazine.

name: Koraidon
description: This seems to be the Winged King mentioned in an old expedition journal. It was said to have split the land with its bare fists.

name: Miraidon
description: This seems to be the Iron Serpent mentioned in an old book. The Iron Serpent is said to have turned the land to ash with its lightning.

name: Walking Wake
description: This ferocious creature is shrouded in mystery. It's named after an aquatic monster mentioned in an old expedition journal.

name: Iron Leaves
description: According to the few eyewitness accounts that exist, it used its shining blades to julienne large trees and boulders.

name: Dipplin
description: The head sticking out belongs to the fore-wyrm, while the tail belongs to the core-wyrm. The two share one apple and help each other out.

name: Poltchageist
description: Supposedly, the regrets of a tea ceremony master who died before perfecting his craft lingered in some matcha and became a Pokémon.

name: Sinistcha
description: It prefers cool, dark places, such as the back of a shelf or the space beneath a home's floorboards. It wanders in search of prey after sunset.

name: Ogerpon
description: This mischief-loving Pokémon is full of curiosity. It battles by drawing out the type-based energy contained within its masks.

name: Archaludon
description: It digs holes on mountains, searching for food. It’s so durable that being caught in a cave-in won’t faze it.

name: Hydrapple
description: These capricious syrpents have banded together. On the rare occasion that their moods align, their true power is unleashed.

name: Gouging Fire
description: There are scant few reports of this creature being sighted. One short video shows it rampaging and spouting pillars of flame.

name: Raging Bolt
description: It's said to incinerate everything around it with lightning launched from its fur. Very little is known about this creature.

name: Iron Boulder
description: It was named after a mysterious object recorded in an old book. Its body seems to be metallic.

name: Iron Crown
description: There was supposedly an incident in which it launched shining blades to cut everything around it to pieces. Little else is known about it.

name: Terapagos
description: It’s thought that this Pokémon lived in ancient Paldea until it got caught in seismic shifts and went extinct.

name: Pecharunt
description: Its peach-shaped shell serves as storage for a potent poison. It makes poisonous mochi and serves them to people and Pokémon.
